tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ /

༄༅/ /rdo rje sgrol ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gusapas phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pas/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma bsgom pa'i tshul ni/ stan bde ba la bsdad la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba bya/sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du rje btsun ma sgrol ma bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ de nas oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā ཿ swa bhā wa bi shud+dho3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas bdag dang snang ba thams cad stong par bsgom | stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba/ dra ba/ gur | blare/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i nang du dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba'i pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar tām̐ las ut+pa la 'i steng du aḥlas sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa las 'od zer phar 'phros sems can gyi don byas | tshur 'dus gcig tu 'dres pa las rang nyid rdo rje sgrol ma sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ pad+ma'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas kyis ut+pa las mtshan pa'i gri gug g.yon gyis thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ yab don yod rdo rje ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ g.yon pas des yu ba byas pa' ི dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che dang dar gyi rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan zhing*/ zhi ba dang sgeg pa la sogs pa'i nyams dang ldan pa snang la rang bzhin med pa/me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bur bsgom/ gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po bsgoms nas/ snying gi nang gi tām̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang

bzhin gyi gnas nas rang gis bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs rang la gnyis su med par bstim/ yang 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas sangs rgyas rnams kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing ye shes lnga'i ngo bo bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas dri ma thams cad dag dbang bzhi thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pas rang nyid sgrol ma'i spyi bor don yod grub pa dang yab don yod grub pa la rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan par bsam/ de nas lha'i sku de nyid la sems gtad nas yid mnyam par bzhag de nas yid 'phro zhing sngags zlo bar 'dod na snying gi nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tām̐ gi mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba'i 'od kyis bdag dang gzhan gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshogs gnyis rgyas/ sems can thams cad dbang du bsdus | sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes rang gi rgyud la 'jug par bsgom zhing*/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ zhes pa dang*/ oṃ a mo gha sid+dhi khaṃ swā hā/ zhes ci nus pa bzla | bzlas pa'i mthar spyod lam la 'jug pa'i tshe/ bdag dang snang ba thams cad lha'i sku/ brjod pa dang grag pa thams cad sngags/ sems kyi rnam par rtog pa thams cad ting nge 'dzin du shes par byas nas phyi rol gyi 'dod yon thams cad kyis rang gi lus kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor la mchod par bsam zhing sdang zhen med par spyad do/ /gtor ma gtong ba'i tshe/ gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis ye shes kyi bdud ∶ rtsi'i rgya mtshor (《 lu 》 rtsir ) byin gyis brlab/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rang gis bsgoms pa lta bu'i sgrol ma yab yum sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs pa la gtor ma phul bar bsgom zhing*/

oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re a mo gha sid+dhi sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ gṛ h+ṇa gṛ h+ṇa kha kha khā hi khā hi hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes lan gsum mam bdun gyis dbul/ 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab/ gtor ma'i mgron gshegs su gsol nas/ gtor ma gtong ngo*/ /zas za ba'i tshe kha zas gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlab/ rang gi lus rje btsun ma sgrol ma yab yum dang | lus kyi cha shas la yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i rnal 'byor ma dang*/ snying ga yan chad 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha tshogs dang*/ snying ga man chad 'jig rten pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyis gang ba la mchod par bsam zhing longs spyod do/ /zas kyi lhag ma/ oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ta ba liṃ ta bha k+ṣa sī swā hā/ zhes pas lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po rnams la sbyin no/ /nub mor nyal ba'i tshe stong pa nyid kyi ngang la nyal lo/ / nangs par ldang ba'i tshe lha'i nga rgyal gyis langs la kun tu spyod pa thams cad la 'jug par bya'o/ /tshul 'dis rtag tu gnas par byas na/ rdo rje sgrol ma'i go 'phang ring por mi thogs par thob par 'gyur ro/ /'di'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa/ 'phags ma sgrol ma/ slob dpon ra bi gup+ta/ tsan+d+ra gar+bha/ dze tā ri | wā gī shwa ra kīrti/ shrad+dhā ka ra warma/ ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta/ dā na shrī/ mañju shrī | mal lo tsā ba/ pu tser lo tsā ba/ ī shwa ra kīrti/ dharma si haṃ/ s+thi ra ma ti/ ga ga na kīrti/ ār+ya ma ti dh+wa dza shrī bha dra rnams las brgyud pa'o/ /rdo rje sgrol ma sgrub pa'i thabs/ thang ngo ta'i don du/ dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa 'phags pas me mo yos bu'i lo/ zla ba gcig pa'i tshe nyi shu bdun la dpal sa skyar sbyar ba'o// // ༄༅/ /sgrol ma lus dkyil gyi sgrub thabs bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'i rim pa/ 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po re zhig sngags pas dam tshig pa spyi'i mngon par rtogs pa la sogs pa ltar dam tshig sems dpa' bskyed nas

| ye shes pa spyan drangs pa'i sku la lha mo nyi shu rtsa lnga'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs shing | sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba bdag la bstim pa'i dbang gis/ rang gi lus kyi rten khog pa (《 lu 》+ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje ces bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang*/ rkang mthil rlung*/ sum mdo me sogs 'byung ba rim brtsegs dang | lus 'dom gang gru bzhi sogs/ gzhal yas khang pa ) rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi gnas/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang bcas pa dang*/ brten pa khams dang yi ge rnams lha mo nyi shu rtsa lngar bsgom par bya ste/ de yang snying gi nang du pad+ma dang zla ba la gnas pa'i rje btsun ma sgrol ma bdag nyid ∶ kyis (《 lu 》 dam tshig sems dpa' yab yum ji ltar ) bsgoms pa ltar bsam par bya'o/ /de bzhin du spyi bo pul+lī ra mā la yar pu las myur zhing rab tu dpa' mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag brgyad ma dang po gnyis rab tu dga' ba'i phyag rgya bcas shing*/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu/ g.yas kyi lhag ma gnyis 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis kyis dung dang zhags pa bsnams pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /spyi gtsug dzā lan+dha rar dzā las ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ dkar mo zhal gsum phyag bcu gnyis ma/ zhal g.yas sngo g.yon ser zhing phyag dang po gnyis kyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya dang*/ lhag ma'i phyag rnams kyis kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang*/ 'khor lo dang*/ rin po che/ rdo rje/ me tog gi phreng ba/ g.yon rnams kyis ril ba spyi blugs | ut+pa la/ dril bu/ bum pa/ pu sti bsnams pa'o/ /rna ba g.yas pa au ḍ+yan du u las gser gyi mdog can ma/ ser mo zhal gcig phyag bcu/ phyag g.yas rnams na phreng ba/ ral gri/ mda'/ rdo rje/ dbyug pa/ g.yon rnams na dar dpyangs/ zhags pa/ pad+ma/ dril bu/ gzhu bsnams pa'o/ /ltag pa arbu dar a las gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma phyag g.yas gnyis kyis mchog sbyin dang phreng ba/

g.yon gnyis kyis ril ba spyi blugs dang dbyu gu bsnams pa'o/ /rna ba g.yon pa go dā wa rīr go las hūm̐ sgra rab tu sgrogs ma ser mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas skyabs sbyin dang g.yon pad+ma ser po bsnams pa'o/ /smin ma'i dbus su rā me shwa rir ra las sgrol ma sku'i dbang phyug ma dkar mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ zhal g.yas gnag g.yon dmar ba/ phyag g.yas gsum na 'khor lo/ pad+ma/ rdo rje/ g.yon gsum na ral gri/ dril bu/ nor bu bsnams pa'o/ /mig gnyis de bī ko ṭar de las 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang ral gri | g.yon gnyis sdigs mdzub dang zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /phrag pa gnyis mā la war ma las gzhan 'joms ma/ khro mo nag mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis kyis skye gnas kyi steng du zhags pa 'dzin pa dang sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'o/ /mchan khung gnyis kā ma rū par ka las bdud thams cad 'joms shing dbang mchog ster ma ser mo/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ chu srin la skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa/ g.yas na mya ngan med pa'i shing dang rin po che/ g.yon na pad+ma dang bum pa bsnams pa'o/ /nu ma gnyis o ḍir o las 'dod pa thams cad rab tu sbyin ma mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ dang po gnyis kyis thugs kar rab tu dga' ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ g.yas kyi gnyis pas gar byed pa'i tshul dang*/ g.yon gyi gnyis pas mya ngan med pa'i shing bsnams pa'o/ /lte ba tri sha ku ner tri las mya ngan thams cad sel bar byed ma dmar po/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis spyi bor rab tu dga' ba'i phyag rgya mdzad cing*/ g.yas kyi gnyis pas ral gri dang*/ g.yon gyi gnyis pas mya ngan med pa'i shing bsnams pa'o/ /sna rtse ko sa lar ko las 'gro ba thams cad 'gugs shing phongs pa thams cad sel bar mdzad ma khro mo mun pa'i mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/

g.yas pa lcags kyus gza' brgyad 'gugs shing g.yon pas zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ kha ka liṅgar ka las bkra shis thams cad sbyin ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag brgyad ma g.yas rnams na rtse gsum/ lcags kyu/ rdo rje/ ral gri/ g.yon rnams na rin po che zhags pa/ dbyu gu/ bum pa bsnams pa'o/ /mgrin pa lam+bā kar lam̐ las sgrol ma gsung gi dbang phyug ma dmar mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ zhal g.yas dkar g.yon gnag pa/ phyag g.yas na pad+ma/ rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ g.yon na nor bu/ dril bu | ral gri bsnams pa'o/ /snying ga kāñcir kā las sgrol ma thugs kyi dbang phyug ma nag mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ zhal g.yas dmar g.yon dkar ba/ phyag g.yas na rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ pad+ma/ g.yon na dril bu/ ral gri/ nor bu bsnams pa'o | | mdom bar hi mā la yar hi las yongs su smin par byed ma/ khro mo dmar mo | zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas na ral gṛ dang mda'/ g.yon na 'khor lo dang gzhu bsnams pa'o/ /rtags kyi rtse (《 lu 》+ mo ) pre ta pu rir pre las 'gugs par byed pa'i khro mo nag mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ g.yas dkar ba g.yon dmar ba/ phyag g.yas rnams na ral gri/ lcags kyu/ dbyu gu/ g.yon rnams na thod pa zhags pa/ ∶ mgo ba (《 lu 》 'khor lo ) bsnams pa'o/ / bshang lam gṛ ha de bar gṛ las zhi ba chen mo dkar mo zhal gcig phyag drug ma/ phyag g.yas rnams na phreng ba mchog sbyin dbyu gu/ g.yon na pad+ma ril ba spyi blugs pu sti bsnams pa'o/ /brla gnyis sau raṣ+tar sau las chags pa 'joms ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas pa rtse gsum dang*/ g.yon pa ut+pa la dang bcas pa'i phyag rgya rked par 'jog pa'o/ /byin pa su war+ṇ+ṇa dwī par su las bde ba thams cad sgrub ma dmar ser/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag gnyis kyis thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsnams pa'o/ /rkang lag gi sor mo bcu drug na ga rar na las rnam par rgyal ma ngang pa'i steng na sems pa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/

dkar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ dang po gnyis kyis rab tu dga' ba'i phyag rgya mdzad cing g.yas kyi gnyis pas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon gyi gnyis pas rdo rje khu tshur dkur 'jog pa'o/ /bol gong gnyis sin+dhur si las sdug bsngal thams cad sreg ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag gnyis kyis thugs kar me thab bsnams pa'o/ /mthe bong ma ror ma las dngos grub thams cad 'byung ma dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag gnyis kyis gser gyi bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa'o/ /pus mo gnyis ku lu tār ku las yongs su rjogs par byed ma dkar mo khyu mchog la gnas pa'i khro mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas pa bgrang phreng dang g.yon pas rtse gsum bsnams pa'o/ /de ltar lha thams cad kyang snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar gsal btab nas/ slar yang de dag rjes su mtshungs pa'i ye shes pa spyan drangs pa bstim la sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs nas | sa bon gyi 'od kyis dbang gi lha 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs pa la bstim | mchod pa rnams kyis mchod nas gsol ba btab pas dbang bskur nas phyi nang gi gtso mo la don yod grub pa dang*/ gzhan thugs kyi lha rnams la mi bskyod pa dang*/ gsung gi lha rnams la 'od dpag tu med pa dang*/ sku'i lha rnams la rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par bsam mo/ /de dag la phyi dang nang dang*/ yid las byung ba'i mchod pas mchod nas phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig pas bstod la spyi dang so so'i rnam pa la rim pa bzhin yid gzung bar bya'o/ /de nas bsgom par 'dod na man ngag las 'byung ba bzhin rdzogs pa'i rim pa'ang bsgom par bya ste man ngag ni gzhan dang thun mong ba nyid do/ /de ltar mnyam par bzhag pa las langs nas gang la 'phro bar gyur pa'i sngags kyi bzlas pa yang ji srid skyo bar ma gyur pa de srid bzla bar bya'o/ /gtor ma la sogs pa'i yan lag gzhan ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/

/rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'i man ngag gi rim pa grub pa brnyes pa'i kha che'i slob dpon nyi ma sbas pa'i zhal las brgyud pa'i gdams ngag 'phags pas sbyar ba'o// // ༄༅/ /slob dpon thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyi sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ aṣ+ta bha ye bh+ya ṇā stā rā sā dha naṃ/ bod skad du/ 'jigs pa brgyad las skyob pa'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ bcom ldan 'das sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po kho nar tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgoms nas/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa dang*/ lam la gnas par khas 'che ba dang yongs su bsngo ba ste bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o/ /de nas chos thams cad bdag med par lhag par mos la/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ

| zhes brjod pas stong pa nyid du bsgom/ ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o | | stong pa nyid kyi ngang las nam mkha'i dbyings de nyid du pad+ma dang*/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ rang gi sems tāṃ gi rnam pa yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i sgrol ma mdog ljang gu/ zhal gcig phyag brgyad ma/ phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis bgrang phreng dang*/ mchog sbyin dang*/ mi 'jigs pa dang*/ rin po che 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis ut+pa la dang*/ bum pa dang*/ skyabs sbyin pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ pusti 'dzin pa/ rab tu zhi zhing lang tsho rgyas pa'i lus shin tu mdzes pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis mngon par spras shing*/ smad g.yogs kha dog sna tshogs can du bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas/ oṃ āḥ ∶ ya hi (《 zha 》 h+ye ) bha ga wa tī prā sā ∶ dhaṃ (《 zha 》 dāṃ da yaṃ ) ku ru pū dza gṛh+ṇa a tra san+ni hi to bha wa/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis bcom ldan 'das ma spyan drangs pa mdun na gnas pa la mngon par mchod de/ oṃ bha ga wa tī sa ma ye shwa ri sarba ∶ nud+dharma (《 zha 》 bud+dha ma ) te tā re a dhiṣ+ṭhā naṃ me ku ru swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis gsol ba btab pas bdag nyid la nye bar zhugs pas snying gar bdag ci 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' dang*/ de'i yang thugs kar tāṃ gi rnam pa'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' gnas par blta zhing*/ de nyid kyi tshe 'jigs pa brgyad las skyob par byed pa'i sgrol ma rnams mngon par 'phros pa ni/ g.yas phyogs su seng ge'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i sgrol ma seng ge'i gdong pa can mche ba gtsigs shing*/ lce glog ltar 'gyu ba/ spyan ser mo phyag gnyis pa/ mdog dmar mo/ skra ser po/ thugs kar mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgya mdzad pa | rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa sems can rnams seng ge'i 'jigs pa las sgrol ba bsgom par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ma'i g.yon phyogs su glang po che'i 'jigs pa las skyab pa'i sgrol ma glang po che'i gdong pa can zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma shangs mtho zhing mche ba gtsigs pa gsus pa 'phyang ba du ba'i mdog can mthe bong mngon par brkyang ba'i phyag gnyis kyis bsdigs par mdzad pa'i phyag rgya can/

sems can rnams glang po che'i 'jigs pa las sgrol bar mdzad pa bsgom par bya'o/ /g.yas phyogs kyi 'og tu me'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i sgrol ma dmar mo 'bar ba'i gdong pa can/ zhal bdun pa/ ljags bdun pa/ skra gyen du 'bar zhing phyag gnyis ma/ phyag gnyis pad+ma'i phyag rgya mdzad cing*/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ sems can rnams me'i 'jigs pa las sgrol ba bsgom par bya'o/ /g.yon phyogs kyi 'og gi char sbrul gyi 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i sgrol ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma kha dog nag mo sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bcu dang ldan zhing*/ skra grol ba rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i lus phyag gnyis kyis mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgya mdzad cing*/ sems can rnams sbrul gyi 'jigs pa las sgrol ba bsgom par bya'o/ /g.yas phyogs kyi 'og gi char chom rkun gyi 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i sgrol ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ sku mdog ljang gu zhal khro gnyer bsdus pa skra gyen du mardzes pa/ phyag g.yas pas ral gri 'phyar zhing g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i lus bzhengs pa/ sems can rnams chom rkun gyi 'jigs pa las sgrol ba bsgom par bya'o/ /g.yon phyogs kyi 'og gi char lcags sgrog gi 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i sgrol ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma sku mdog dmar mo g.yas pa dang g.yon pas lcags kyu zhags pa 'dzin cing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i lus bzhengs pa sems can rnams lcags sgrog gi 'jigs pa las sgrol ba bsgom par bya'o/ /g.yas phyogs kyi 'og gi char chu'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i sgrol ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ sku mdog dkar mo g.yas pa lcags kyu dang g.yon pas sdig mdzub mdzad pa/zhi ba'i sku bzhengs pa/ sems can rnams chu'i 'jigs pa las sgrol ba bsgom par bya'o/ /g.yon phyogs kyi 'og gi char sha za'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i sgrol ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa kun+da dang zla ba'i mdog can

rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i lus | phyag g.yas pa dang g.yon pas mchog sbyin pa dang*/ mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgya mdzad cing*/ sems can rnams sha za'i 'jigs pa las sgrol ba'i sgrol ma bsgom par bya'o/ /yang snying ga'i tām̐ gi 'od zer gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga spyan drangs pa la mngon par mchod nas gsol ba btab pas sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur nas thams cad la don yod grub pas dbur brgyan par bsgom par bya'o/ /sngags tshig ni 'di dag yin te/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re sarba bha ya sha ma ni sarba durga ti tā ri ṇa tu re swā hā/ gtso mo'i sngags so/ /oṃ siṃ ha ba dā ni ma hā daṃṣ+tīṃ/ bi d+yud dzi hī sī ga la ne tra gar+dz+dza ya gar+dz+dza ya tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā | seng ga'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i sgrol ma'i sngags so/ /oṃ dwi ra daṃ ba dā ni e ka daṃṣ+tīṃ ma hā na se lam+bo dha ri/ kar+dha kar+dha/ trā sa ya trā sa ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ glang po che'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i sgrol ma'i sngags so | | oṃ shi ṣi ba dā ne ma hā u skā mu khi dz+wa lā mā lā ni sap+ta dzi hi/ sap+ta mu khiṃ/ wi shwa na ri tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ me'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i sgrol ma'i sngags so | | oṃ pha ni ma hā pha ni kriṣ+ṇa ba dwa ne/ kriṣ+ṇa ba dā ne kre e kā da sha dzi he kā re ṇa/ tsa la ya tsa la ya ma hā bhi ṣa bak+ṣa ni/ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ sbrul gyi 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i sgrol ma'i sngags so/ /oṃ kharga ha sti bhṛ ku ṭi mu khi ∶ ur+dha (《 zha 》 ur dar+dha ) ke sha ma hā na di kṛṣ+ṇa añja na war+ṇe ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da/ bhin+da bhin+da ut+tā ra ya ut+tā ta ra ya/ tā re tut+tā re tu te swā hā/ chom rkun gyi 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i sgrol ma'i sngags so/ /oṃ rak+ṣa war+ṇe pā sha aṃ ku sha ha sti ma hā ra wi ma hā ba la sa ra sa ra/

bi sa ra bi sa ra/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+na/ kad+dha kad+dha/ ma hā durga na/ mu tsa ya/ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ lcags sgrog gi 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i sgrol ma'i sngags so/ /oṃ dza le dza le ma hā dza le/ tā ra ya tā ra ya/ ut+tā ra ya/ shri kha la ha sti/ ma hā dza we e ka bī ri ma hā kā ru ṇi ke tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ chu'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i sgrol ma'i sngags so/ /oṃ ma hā gam+bhir+ye ma hā kā ru ṇi ke bha ga wat+sa le ba ra dha a bha ya ha sti/ ma hā ku nin+du da ba li/ pra hā si ta ba dā ne ma hā bas+t+ra pra bit+ta shā ri re dh+ya nā was+thi ti/ tā ra ya tā ra ya/ ma hā bha ya tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ sha za'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i sgrol ma'i sngags so/ /gang gi tshe bzlas pas yid skyo bar gyur pa de'i tshe ye shes pa mdun du phyung ba la mchod nas gshegs su gsol/ rang nyid dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par bya'o/ /'jigs pa brgyad las skyob pa'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ slob dpon thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa rdzogs so/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta ta thā ga ta bha dra dang*/ dge slong 'phags pas rgya'i yul cang to mkhar du bsgyur ba'o// // ༄༅/ /gnas kyi dbang phyug ma'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /srid gsum 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las sgrol ba/ /sgrol ma dpal mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas/ /de nyid mnyes par byed pa sgrub pa'i thabs/ /man ngag ji bzhin bdag gis bri bar bya/ /au ḍ+yan sgrol ma bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa sngon du song nas rang gi snying gi nang du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tām̐ gi yi ge dmar por gsal btab la/ de las byung ba'i 'od kyis tshogs kyi zhing spyan drangs te de la mchod nas yan lag bdun pa bya/ tshad med pa bzhi bsgom/ shū n+ya tā'i sngags kyis stong par bsgom/

stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las byung ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du e las chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi nang du pam̐ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i snying po la ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan gyi steng du tām̐ dmar po las ut+pa la dmar po tām̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus nas yongs su gyur pa las | rang nyid rje btsun ma sgrol ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa ba'i zhal dmar ba/ g.yas nag g.yon ljang ba/ steng zhal ser po zhal re re zhing spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis ḍa ma ru dang*/ khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang*/ ral gri dang rdo rje bsnams shing g.yon pa rnams kyis ut+pal dmar po dang*/ rin po che dang*/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang*/ dril bu bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'bar zhing stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsgoms nas | de'i spyi bor bh+rūm̐ dkar po/ mgrin par hrīḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ nag po/ lte bar a ser po/ brla gnyis la kham̐ ljang gu bkod la snying ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas au ḍ+yan gyi gnas nas rje btsun ma sgrol ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ me tog la sogs pas mchod nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'phros pa'i 'od kyis bkug nas bdag la bstim par bsam zhing*/ oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga wa tī ma hā kā ru ṇi ka tā rā sa mā dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas gnyis su med par gyur par bsam mo/ /yang 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/

me tog la sogs pas mchod nas/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bum pa'i chus dbang bskur zhing*/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin//oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐ su ra te s+t+waṃ/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas/ dbang gi chu rgyun gyis rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dgadabang bzhi thob/chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rigs lngas dbur brgyan par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra dhā tu ī shwa rī a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra satwa badz+ra abhi ṣiñca bh+rūm̐/ oṃ rat+na badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca trāṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dharma a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ.oṃ karma badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca āḥzhes brjod do/ /de nas lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa de nyid la dmigs pa gtad la yid mnyam par bzhag go /gal te sngags kyi bzlas pa byed par 'dod na/ snying ga'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tām̐ gi mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng ba 'khor ba'i 'od kyi rnam pas rang gzhan gyi sdig sgrib bsal zhing*/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnad nas bskul bar dmigs te/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re ∶ swā hā (《 zha 》 hūm̐ phaṭa ) / zhes ji srid mi skyo'i bar du bzla'o/ /gang gi tshe gtor ma btang bar 'dod pa de'i tshe/ mngon par bshams pa'i rdzas bde mchog las 'byung ba'i cho ga'i rim pas byin gyis brlabs nas rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyi snang bas bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs la gtor ma 'bul bar bsam zhing | oṃ tā te tut+tā re tu re/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ ma tha ma tha/ sarba duṣ+tān i maṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa ma ma sarba kar+yaṃ ni sā dha ya sā dha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum gyis dbul zhing*/ mngon par mchod nas 'dod pa'i don la gsol gdab bo/

/mthar yi ge brgya pa brjod nas lha gshegs su gsol/ gtor ma'i cho ga'o// // 'dod chags rang bzhin las byung zhing*/ /'dod chags dag pa'i bdag nyid can/ /brtse bas 'gro la rjes chags pa/ /'gro ba'i mar gyur phyag 'tshal lo/ khro la rnam par khro ba dang*/ /gti mug can la kun rmongs dang*/ /zhi la nye bar zhi sogs kyis/ /don mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /au ḍ-i ya nar rab sprul zhing*// rnam 'phrul gzhan du'ang kun sprul pa/ /gnas rnams kun la dbang mdzad ma/ / gnas kyi dbang phyug ma la 'dud/ /sku mdog dmar po 'bar chen mo/ /zhal bzhi ma la phyag brgyad ma/ /gar gyis rol pa'i stabs bzhugs shing*/ /rnam par rtsen la phyag 'tshal lo/ /g.yas gnag g.yon ljang steng zhal ser/ /zhal rer spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs/ /dbu skra gyen 'khyil stag lpags can / /rgyan rnams kun gyis sgeg la 'dud/ /ḍa ma ru dang thod khrag dang*/ /ral gri rdo rje g.yas rnams na/ /g.yon pas ut+pal rin chen dang*/ kha ṭ+wāṃ dril bu bsnams la 'dud/ / sku las rgyal ba'i sprul pa 'phro/ /gsung gis rig sngags 'brug ltar sgrogs/ / kun tu khyab pa'i thugs mnga' ba/ /sna tshogs dbang phyug ma la 'dud/ /mi mthun phyogs kun zhi ba dang*/ /don kun yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub kun/ /bdag la nye bar stsal du gsol/ /zhes nam skabs su babs pa'i tshe/ tshig 'di dag gis bstod cing gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /'di'i brgyud pa'i rim pa ni/ sgrol ma/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gdan ma/ grub pa'i slob dpon sa ra he ta/ bi ni ta bha dra/ paṇ+ḍi ta saṃ gra ma shrī/ slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rje | slob dpon shākya'i rdo rje/ slob dpon mngon pa ba/ dbang phyug brtson 'grus/ 'phags pa rnams yin no/ /de ltar au ḍ+yan rim pa las byung ba'i/ /gnas kyi dbang phyug ma yi sgrub pa'i thabs/ /bkra shis bla ma zhes byas gsol btab nas//sngags 'chang 'phags pa zhes byas sbyar ba yin/

/de las dge ba'i rtsa ba gang bskrun pa/ /de yis gsol ba 'debs pas gtsor byas pa'i/ /mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyis/ /sgrol ma'i go 'phang dam pa thob par shog / gnas kyi dbang phyug ma zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs 'di ni me mo yos bu'i lo smin drug gi zla ba'i tshes nyi shu bdun gyi nyin par 'dam gyi sa cha gad skya zhes bya bar sbyar ba'o// // ༄༅/ /rdo rje gur gyi rjes su 'brang ba sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi rjes su 'brang ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang rje btsun ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo | | dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang kun gyi/ /phrin las dge ba gcig bsdus pa/ / sgrol ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas/ /de yi sgrub pa'i rim pa bshad/ /dbang

dang rjes gnang thob gyur cing*/ /dam tshig la gnas sgrub pa pos/ /mnyam par bzhag dang thun mtshams kyi/ /rnal 'byor gnyis la gnas par bya/ /de yang stan bde ba la ting nge 'dzin gyi 'dug stangs kyis gnas nas/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/sems bskyed pa sngon du song nas/ snying gi nang du zla ba la gnas pa'i tām̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ rang gi sgrib pa sbyangs shing phyir 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor bla ma gtso mo'i rigs bdag tu bzhugs pa spyan drangs pa la/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥdang*/ na ma stā rā bha ga wa tī maṇ+ḍa la bh+yaḥs phyag 'tshal nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra tā rā bha ga wa twi/ zhes pa sngon du 'gro ba'i ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi | | la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa dang*/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad la sogs pa'i sdom pa gzung ba lan gsum byas nas/ tshad med pa bzhi bsgoms la/ oṃ badz+ra muḥs tshogs kyi zhing gshegs su gsol ba ni bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o/ /de nas/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ bdag dang snang ba thams cad stong par bsgom pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o/ /stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang sngo/ lte ba ljang gu la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ ra ba/ dra ba/ gur/ bla re/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du/ e las chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi khong du/ yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ pam̐ las chu/ lam̐ las sa/ bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo dkar po bh+rūm̐ gyis mtshan pa las rang gi sems 'dres pa las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin dkar po/ ser po/ dmar po/ sngon po/

ljang gu'i rtsig pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser po la dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa 'phyang ba | de'i steng du mda' yab kyis yongs su bskor ba/ phyi 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la lha mo bcu drug gis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas mchod pa byed pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan zhing rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bres nas mdzes par phub ba'i steng du rin po che dang bcas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i tog gis mtshan pa'i sgo'i thad so bzhir rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i steng du pad+ma dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ ri dwags dang*/ gdugs dang bcas shing*/ gzhan yang zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang*/ rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can dang*/ me tog gi phreng ba dang*/ me long dang*/ gos dang 'phan la sogs pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis spras pa/ dwangs shing sgrib pa med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang sngo ba'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang*/ phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma dang*/ steng 'og tu zla ba'i gdan sgo bzhir nyi ma'i gdan/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma'i mtshams bzhir bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bzhi | phyi'i grwa rnams su bdud rtsis gang zhing dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa'i bum pa brgyad bsam par bya'o/ /de nas gdan dbus ma'i steng du ā li phrag gnyis las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha dang bcas pa'i kā li phrag gnyis las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du tām̐ las rdo rje tām̐ gis mtshan pa/ gsum ka 'dres pa las rang nyid rje btsun sgrol ma sku mdog ljang ser zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa ba'i zhal ljang*/ g.yas sngo/ rgyab dkar | g.yon dmar ba/ phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis/ rdo rje/ zhags pa/ dung*/ mda' 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis lcags kyu/ ut+pa la/ sdigs mdzub/ gzhu bsnams pa/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing*/

rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa | dar sna tshogs pa'i na bza' mnabs pa bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du gnas pa'i tām̐ las/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ rnams spros pa nang gi phyogs bzhi dang*/ sgo bzhi 'og dang steng gi gdan rnams la bkod pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i shar gyi 'dab ma la me tog sgrol ma dkar mo me tog 'dzin pa/ lhor bdug spos sgrol ma sngon mo/ spos kyi dud pa 'thul ba'i spos khang 'dzin pa/ nub tu mar me sgrol ma ser mo mar me 'dzin pa/ byang du dri'i sgrol ma dmar mo dri bzang po'i chus gang ba'i dung chos 'dzin pa/ shar sgor lcags kyu ma dkar mo/ lhor zhags pa ma sngon mo/ nub tu lcags sgrog ma ser mo/ byang sgor dril bu ma dmar mo rang gi ming gi phyag mtshan 'dzin cing*/ g.yon brkyang pas bzhengs pa stag dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa'o/ /'og tu gnod mdzes ma sngon mo sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ steng du gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma ser mo/ phyag gnyis kyis spyi bor 'khor lo 'dzin pa la/ sgo ma ma gtogs pa rnams ni rab tu zhi zhing sgeg ma rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /lha zhi ba rnams kyi thugs kar zla ba dang*/ sgo ma rnams kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du so so'i sa bon bkod pa las 'od zer 'phros pa las snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang*/ bcud thams cad sgrol ma'i lha tshogs su gyur nas 'od zer tshur 'dus pas sa bon so so la thim par bsam mo/ /de nas lha thams cad kyi mig tu gti mug rdo rje dang*/ spyi bor sku rdo rje la sogs pas skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gi snying gi nang gi tām̐ las 'od phyir 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rang gis bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba spyan drangs pa la snga ma ltar mchod nas/

rang gi snying ga nas spros pa'i lcags kyu/ zhags pa/ lcags sgrog dril bu ma rnams spros pas ye shes pa rnams dgug pa dang*/ gzhug pa dang*/ bcing ba dang*/ dbang du bya bar bsams nas so so'i phyag rgya bcings la/ oṃ e h+ye hi sarba ta thā ga ta tā rā bha ga wa tī sa pa ri wā ra/ zhes kun la sbyar la/ badz+ra aṃ gu sha dzaḥbadz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ zhes brjod pas dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par bya'o/ /de nas yang snying ga'i tām̐ las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga/ yum bzhi byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo dang mchod pa'i lha mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs pa la sngar ltar mchod nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa'i/ /rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ /oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bh-i ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur | yum rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa mdzad/ dbang gi chu rgyun des rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pas gtso mo la don yod grub pa/ dbus na bzhugs pa'i rigs lnga dang*/ shar gyi gnyis la rnam par snang mdzad dang*/ lho'i gnyis la rin chen 'byung ldan/ nub kyi gnyis la 'od dpag med/ byang gi gnyis la mi bskyod pa/ 'og gi la rnam par snang mdzad/ steng gi la mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsam mo | | de nas dbang gi lha gshegs su gsol la/ rang gi snying ga nas spros pa'i me tog la sogs pa phyi'i mchod pa dang*/ bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa nang gi mchod pa dang*/ mchod rdzas du ma 'dzin pa'i lha mo rnams spros pas rang gis bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha

rnams mchod par bsams nas/ slar yang de dag gis bstod par bsam zhing*/ 'gro ba bud med 'dul gzigs nas | | rdo rje sgrol mar gang gyur pa/ /phyag 'tshal pha rol phyin thub ma/ /sgyu ma'i phyag rgyar phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces brjod nas lha mo rnams rang gi snying gar thim par bsam mo/ /de nas mdun du bdud rtsi yod pa'am med kyang rung ste/ gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs pa des/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams mchod par bsams nas myangs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra a mṛ ta swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor snang la rang bzhin med pa la yid gtad de/ sems mnyam par bzhag go /bskyed pa'i rim pa'o// // rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa'i tshul ni/ kye'i rdo rje dang mtshungs pa nyid do/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa ste mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de nas sngags zlo bar 'dod pas thugs ka'i sa bon las sngags kyi phreng bas 'khor ba'i 'od kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa dag bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rgyas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rgyud bskul bas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ na maḥ.ār+ya a wa lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi sa twā ya/ ma hā sa twā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā oṃ tā re tut+tā te tu re sarba duṣ+tāṃ praṣ+tāṃ ma ma kṛ te/ dzam+bha ya/ staṃ bha ya/ mo ha ya/ ban+dha ya/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ sarba duṣ+tāṃ stam+bha ni tā rā yai swā hā/ rtsa ba'i sngags so/ / oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ snying po dang lha thams cad pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ puṣ+pa tā rī swā hā/ oṃ dhū pa tā rī swā hā/ oṃ dā+e pa tā rī swā hā*/ oṃ gan+dha tā rī swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku shī swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā shī swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭā swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍī swā hā/ oṃ

uṣ+ṇī ṣa bi dzā yai swā hā/ oṃ sum+bha nī swā hā/ zhes pa ni 'khor rnams kyi sngags so/ /ji srid mi skyo'i bar du bzla bar bya'o/ /gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa'i tshul ni/ dges pa'i rdo rje dang mtshungs la/ gtor ma'i mgron bdag gis bsgoms pa lta bu'i dkyil 'khor la lha chen po brgyad dang*/ phyogs skyong ba brgyad dang*/ nyi zla dang*/ tshangs pa dang*/ sa'i lha mo dang*/ klu chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba dmigs nas | ye shes pa dang ro gcig par byas la/ dbang bskur nas rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas btab pa la gtor ma phul bas gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re/ in+da dza ma dza la dzak+kha bhū ta bah+ni bā u rak+kha tsan+da sudz+dza ma da pap+pa ta la pa ta le aṣ+ta sap+pa swā hā/ i daṃ ba la ིཾ bhuñja dzi gha phul+la dhū pa maṃ sa piṃ ga am+ba sap+pa kādz+dza sa dā khan+ti khu ni phe ṭa gā da oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ/ ād+ya nut+pan+na twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gsum mam bdun gyis phul nas slar yang me tog la sogs pas mchod la snga ma ltar bstod nas/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /la sogs pas phrin las bcol nas/ rdo rje'i glu dang*/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod la | bzod par gsol zhing gtor ma'i mgron gshegs su gsol la gtor ma gtong ngo*/ /gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ro/ kha zas yi ge gsum gyis ye shes ky-i bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs nas rang sgrol mar dmigs pa'i lte ba nas gtum mo'i me 'bar bas gang ba'i khrod du snying gar dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs gsal bar dmigs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba dang*/ lto bar 'byung po brgyad gsum nyi shu rtsa bzhi la 'jig rten pa thams cad kyis bskor bar dmigs nas lag pa gnyis dgang blugs kyi kha hom khung du bsreg rdzas blugs pas mnyes par bsam zhing bza'o/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ro

| | de nas spyod lam la 'jug pa'i tshe lha rnams bsdus nas/ rang sgrol ma 'ba' zhig tu gnas pa'i sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ zhes brjod pas bdag gi lus dang snang ba thams cad lha/ āḥzhes brjod pas brjod pa dang grag pa thams cad sngags/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas rtog pa'i 'du 'phro thams cad ye shes kyi cho 'phrul du byin gyis brlabs nas/ phyi rol gyi 'dod yon lngas nang gi lha rnams mchod par bsam zhing*/ yul rnams la chags pa dang sdang ba med par spyad do/ /spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ro/ /nyal ba'i tshe/ lha rnams bsdus nas chos kyi sku'i ngang du nyal lo/ /nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ro/ /ldang ba'i tshe chos kyi sku las gzugs kyi skur bzhengs pa'i tshul gyis ldang ngo*/ /ldang ba'i rnal 'byor te | thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor ro/ /de ltar dam tshig dang sdom pa rnam par dag pas rnal 'byor de dag la nan tan du byas pas ting nge 'dzin dam pa skyes pa'i tshe ji skad bshad pa'i spyod pa dag la nye bar spyad pas thun mong gi ∶ dngos grub dag gis (《 zha 》- dngos grub dag gis ) rang dang gzhan gyi yid dga' bar byas nas dbang phyug brgyad kyi phun sum tshogs pa'i phyag rgya chen po mchog gi ga ོ 'phang myur du thob par 'gyur ba nyid do/ /'di'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang dpal bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ /bir+wa pa dang ḍoṃ bi he ru ka /'jam dpal grags pa dzā lan+dha ra ba/ /se'u ri pa 'jigs med 'byung gnas dpal/ /dge ba'i 'byung gnas dpe med srung ba dang*/ /a wa dhū tī dā rbaṇa ā tsār+ya/ /bla ma shes rab rin chen dpal las ni/ /dbang rab thob nas sgrub thabs 'phags pas sbyar/ /de las dge ba'i rtsa ba gang bskrun pa/ /de yis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi | | bsod nams ye shes tshogs rab rdzogs gyur te/ /sgrol ma'i go 'phang dam pa thob par shog /'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi rjes su 'brang ba'i rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs 'di ni chos thams cad la bsnyengs pa mi mnga' ba'i mkhyen rab can chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa/

dge slong sngags 'chang ba 'phags pa zhes bya ba la brtul zhugs dang yon tan gyi rgyan gyis mdzes par grags pa bzang po zhes bya bas dbang bskur ba dang sgrub pa'i thabs zhus pa'i ngor chu pho spre'u'i lo dpyid zla ra ba'i tshes nyi shu gsum gyi snga dro'i cha la/ shing kun du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni a tsa ra'o || || ༄༅/ /phyag drug sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /phyag drug sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro ba sdug bsngal chu bo las/ /sgrol mdzad sgrol mar phyag 'tshal nas/ /sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs sgyu 'phrul gyi/ /rgyud kyi rjes su 'brang ste bshad | | de la thog mar sngags pas phyi dang nang gi bdag nyid kyi khrus kyis lus dang sems dag par byas nas/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa sngon du song nas yan lag bdun pa dang tshad med pa bzhis bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags la/ oṃ shū n+ya tā badz+ra na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ gi sngags kyis chos thams cad mi dmigs pa'i stong par bsgoms la/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bsgom par bya ba ni/ tām̐ gi yi ge las grub pa/ /lha mo sgrol ma rdzu 'phrul che/ /'jo sgeg cha lugs kyis mdzes pa

| | zhal ras gsum pa spyan gsum pa/ /phyag drug sems dpa'i skyil mo krung | | bzhad pa margad mdog dang ldan/ /dang po mi 'jigs sbyin pa'i phyag/gnyis pa na ni rdo rje bsnams/ /gsum pa yis ni mda' yang gsor/ /g.yon pas sdigs pa'i mdzub mo ste/ /gnyis pa na ni ut+pal nyid/ /gsum pa yis ni gzhu yang 'dzin/ /'od zer dmar po 'bar ba can/ /sangs rgyas ∶ 'pho bas (《 zha 》 'phros pas ) rgyas mdzad pa/ /dga' mdzad sems can kun gyi ma/ /rtag par rgyun du bsgom par bya/ /sems can thams cad dbang gyur zhing*/ /dga' bar byed pa'i ye shes rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de'i gnas gsum tu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum bkod nas ye shes pa dang ro gcig par byas la/ dbang gi lha spyan drangs nas gsol ba btab pas dbang bskur nas rigs kyi bdag po don yod grub pa'i rgyas gdab bo/ /de nas lag pa gnyis thal mo snying gar sbyar la mdzub mo gnyis kyi rtse mos gung mo'i tshigs dang por reg nas mthe bong gnyis sbyar te dbus su bzhag pa ut+pa la'i phyag rgya bcas pas/ dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying gar gtug cing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tā ra kā ya a dhi tiṣ+ṭha oṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tā ra wā ka a dh-i tiṣ+ṭha āḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tā ra tsit+ta a dhi tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ | zhes rim pas brjod cing byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la sems gtad de mnyam par bzhag go /de nas sngags bzla bar 'dod na/ snying gar zla ba'i steng du tām̐ gi mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba'i 'od kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin rlabs spyan drangs shing rang la bstim/ rang dang gzhan gyi don gnyis bsgrub par bsam zhing | bzla bar bya ba'i sngags/ phan yon dang bcas pa ni/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis/ /sangs rgyas kun dang sras rnams kyis/ /spyan phye rnam par gdangs nas su/

/ye shes rdo rje ldan pa dran/ /lha mo bzlas brjod byas tsam gyis/ /skye rgu rnams ni mngag gzhug 'gyur/ /de nas dkar gtor oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gis bsgoms pa lta bu'i bcom ldan 'das ma mdun du spyan drangs la sngags snga ma nyid kyis dbul lo | | slar yang mchod cing bstod la 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab nas/ / oṃ badz+ra muḥs gshegs su gsol/ 'di'i srung ba'i 'khor lo dang*/ las kyi tshogs mang po ni sgrol ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs kyi yan lag gzhan las 'byung ba ltar bsgrubs pas 'grub pa nyid do/ /de ltar rgyud kyi rim pa bzhin/ /sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs bshad pa yis/ /'gro ba srid pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /brgal nas bde ba sbyin par shog /phyag drug sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 'phags pas sa pho stag gi lo dbyar zla ra ba'i tshes brgyad la dpal sa skyar sbyar ba 'di'i yi ge pa ni ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa'o// // ༄༅/ /sgrol ma lha bcu bdun ma'i dbang chog bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang rje btsun ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba sdug bsngal las/ /sgrol mdzad sgrol ma la btud de/ /de yi dbang bskur cho ga'i rim | | gzhan gyis bskul phyir bdag gis bshad/ /de la dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa/ snying rjes sems can rjes su 'dzin par 'dod pas/ bsnyen pa sngon du song zhing cho ga'i las la mkhas pa'i mtshan nyid lnga dang ldan pa'i bla ma la dad pa dang*/ snying rje dang*/ byang chub kyi sems dang ldan zhing*/ cho ga'i spyod yul du gyur pa'i yan lag bzhi dang ldan pa'i slob mas/ bla mar gsol ba gdab pa'i phyir maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ / bdag ni dus 'di nas bzung nas/ /snying po byang chub ma thob bar/ /bla ma dam par gsol 'debs kyis/

/bdag gi bla ma mdzad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pa dang*/ bla mas/ ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang*/ /ma grol ba rnams dgrol ba dang*/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung dang*/ /mya ngan ma 'das bzla ba'i phyir/ /bla mar zhu ba khyod spro'am/ /zhes dri'o/ /slob mas kyang*/ ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang*/ /ma grol ba rnams dgrol ba dang*/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung dang*/ /mya ngan ma 'das bzla ba'i phyir/ /bla mar zhu ba bdag spro'o/ /zhes lan gdab bo/ /de nas dkon mchog gi spyan sngar bla ma'i tshig gi rjes su bzlas te/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa lan gsum byas nas/ bla ma dang slob ma gnyis kas slob ma mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las/ hūm̐ las bgegs mthar byed sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can | sbrul dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bskyed nas | oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum gyis lung byin la zlor gzhug go /slob ma rjes su gzung ba'o// // de nas slob mas yo byad sbyar nas bsnyen pa la gnas par gsol ba btab ste/ slob dpon gyis bum pa la brten pa ni bum pa sta gon gyi skabs ltar ram ma brten pa sgrub thabs ltar gtso mo la 'bum phrag brgyad cu/ 'khor rnams la khri phrag brgyad cu'i bar du bzlas pa bya'o/ /bsnyen pa'o/ /de nas sa'i cho ga la phyogs dang*/ dbyibs dang*/ kha dog dang*/ mtshan ma rnams yid du 'ong zhing 'tshe ba med la/ yo byad phun sum tshogs pa ting nge 'dzin ngang gis 'phel ba'i sa phyogs dkyil 'khor gyi gnas su rigs nas/ sa de'i bdag po khyim bdag la sogs pa la ci 'byor pa'i bsnyen bkur byas nas/ sa'i phyogs 'dir dkyil 'khor gyi las rtsom par 'tshal bas gnang bar mdzod cig ces brjod nas

| des kyang gnang ba byin par bsam pa ni mngon pa las bslang ba'o/ /de nas sa'i phyogs der khru gang ba'i maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su dri'i thig le byas la/ de'i steng du me tog gi tshom bu bkod pa'i khor yug tu chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang*/ dkar gtor dang*/ dmar gtor gnyis bsham mo/ /de nas rang nyid sgrol ma'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas me tog gi tshom bu stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma a las zla ba'i steng du bam̐ las sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas pas dpang po khas len pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon pas bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa bskyed pa'i gnas gsum du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ bkod la/ lag pa g.yas pa sa la bsnun pas sa'i lha mo spyan drangs la mdun bskyed la bstim/ dbang gi lha spyan drangs pa la mchod nas 'di la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur / chu lhag ma yar lud pas rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ de la oṃ pṛ th-i wī de wī sngon du sbyar ba'i/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha (《 lu 》+ ye ) swā hā/ la sogs pas mchod nas/ gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī a kā ro la sogs pa lan gsum gyis phul nas/rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par dang*/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la | | lha mo khyod ni dbang du gyur/ /skyob pa shākya seng ge yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi sde/ /pham par byas te dkyil 'khor bri/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab pas/ sa'i lha mos kyang rig pa 'dzin pa khyod ci dga' bar byos shig ces gnang ba byin par bsam mo/ /de nas dmar gtor snga ma ltar byin gyis brlabs nas nag po'i phyogs la dga' ba'i sa'i bdag po thams cad la byin par bsam zhing*/

oṃ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu kha bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ | grih+ne daṃ ba liṃ te swā hā/ zhes gsum mam bdun gyis byin nas/ sa'i phyogs 'di na gnas pa'i gzhi'i bdag po dkyil 'khor chen po blta bar mi dbang ba de dag gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la/ dkyil 'khor gyi las ma tshar gyi bar du sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par song shig gang dag dkyil 'khor blta bar dbang ba de dag ni ma skrag par 'khod la/ dkyil 'khor gyi las bsgrub pa'i stong grogs gyis shig dkyil 'khor chen po'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i/ /lha la sogs pa'i bgegs tshogs kun nyon cig /nga ni gnas 'dir dkyil 'khor chen po bri/ khyed rnams 'di nas gzhan du 'gro bar gyis/ /gal te nga yi tshig las 'da' byed na/ /ye shes can gyi rdo rje 'bar ba yis/ /mgo bo tshal pa brgyar ni 'gas 'gyur zhing*/ /bgegs rnams brlag par 'gyur bar gdon mi za | | zhes brjod nas drag po'i sngags brjod cing*/ rol mo'i sgra drag tu byas la bgegs rnams bskrad par bsam mo/ /de nas sa'i lha mo la mchod nas/ oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī badz+ra muḥs gshegs su gsol nas/ dam tshig pa mi dmigs par bsams la las kyi rjes bsdu'o/ /mi mngon pa las bslang ba ste sa bslang ba'o/ /de nas lto 'phye'i lto ba'i phyogs nas pus mo'am lte ba nub tsam du sa brkos nas | sol ba dang*/ rus pa dang*/ gyo mo dang*/ spu la sogs pa'i zug rngu rnams phyung nas dri bzang dang*/ rin po che'i phye ma dang bcas pa'i sa bzang pos bkang la | 'thas par brdungs nas dkyil 'khor dang 'tsham pa'i sa stegs gru bzhi shar dang byang cung zad gzhol zhing shin tu 'jam pa bya'o/ /de ltar byar mi rung ba'i sa phyogs su lag mthil gyi hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas zug rngu thams cad sbyangs par bsam zhing sa phyogs kun tu lag pas chag chag byas la/

oṃ ha na ha na kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa ces pa dang*/ oṃ bhu khaṃ zhes brjod pas stong par bsam mo/ /de'i dbus su slob dpon rang nyid sgrol ma'i nga rgyal dang*/ phyogs bzhir rigs bzhi'i nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i slob ma bzhis rang rang gi lha yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed nas rdo rje slob dpon bskul ba'i phyir/ shar nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog/dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /zhes pa dang*/ lho nas/ mtshan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /mtshan min thams cad rnam par spangs/ /kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /zhes pa dang*/ nub nas/ zhi ba'i chos mchog las byung ba/ /ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyong mdzad/ /kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /zhes pa dang*/ byang nas/ sems can kun gyi sems chen po/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i dri ma med/ /kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo sgyur/ /dkyil 'khor snying po bshad du gsol | | zhes gsol ba btab nas/ slob dpon gyis/ oṃ badz+ra u tiṣ+ṭha'i sngags dang | rdo rje 'degs pa'i phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gyis dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la bteg nas/ mig g.yas pa ma las nyi ma dang*/ g.yon pa ṭa las zla bar dmigs la/ g.yas nas g.yon du blta bas bgegs thams cad tshar gcad cing*/ g.yon nas g.yas su blta bas rjes su bzung la/ rkang mthil gnyis su sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa re bsams nas rdo rje'i gom pas byang shar du song la/ hūm̐ lus ngag sems la gnas pa'i bgegs/ /'dir nyon nga ni dpal dang ldan/ /bka' yi 'khor lo rab bskor ba/ /nga yi bka' yi dam tshig las/ /su 'das brlag 'gyur the tshom med/ /mi dang mi min 'byung po'i tshogs | | gdon gyi rigs su gtogs pa rnams/ /'di ru ma gnas gzhan du dengs | | zhes pa dang*/ sum+bha la sogs pa'i drag po'i sngags brjod cing rol mo'i sgra drag tu bya'o/

/de nas rdo rje'i 'gros kyis g.yas skor du song la/ shar du g.yas brkyang | lhor g.yon brkyang*/ nub tu sa ga byang du zlum po'i rkang stabs rnams byas pas rkang pa'i rjes rnams sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsams la sa gzung ba'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dug ste/ swa bhā was sa phyogs stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyi snang ba las grub pa'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ ra ba/ dra ba/ gur/ bla bre/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgoms nas/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hās byin gyis brlab bo/ /sa'i cho ga'o// // de nas sta gon du gnas par bya ba'i phyir/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi ba byung dang*/ dri bzang pos byugs pa'i ∶ maṇ+ḍal gyi (《 lu 》 pan reg gi ) phyi'i khor yug tu chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga la sogs pa gang 'byor bas bskor zhing | gos zung*/ nang mchod/ ku sha so shing la sogs pa'i nye bar mkho ba rnams dang*/ gtor ma lnga bshams nas phyem red kyi tshe sgrub pa'i grogs dang bcas pa 'khod la/ sngon du 'gro ba'i gtor ma mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis der 'dus pa'i 'byung po rnams la bsngos nas snod ma yin pa bskrad/ snod dang ldan pa rnams la grogs gzhol/ gnas dang yo byad rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa rgya che bar byin gyis brlabs nas/ rol mo'i sgra drag tu brdungs la/ oṃ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi'i sngags brjod do/ /de nas las kyi slob mas rnal 'byor la gnas par gsol ba btab la/ yi ge brgya pas rgyud sbyangs te/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i dkyil 'khor bsgoms nas/ bzlas pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin bya'o/ /de nas 'khor rnams dang yab rang la bsdu/ rang nyid rje btsun ma'i nga rgyal gyis mchod rdzas rnams bigh+nān+ta kṛta kyis bsang*/

swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ āḥhūm̐ las grub pa'i lha rdzas kyi mchod pa rnams su bskyed la so so'i sngags kyi byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas sa'i lha mo sta gon du gnas pa sa bslang ba'i skabs bzhin du bya'o/ /de nas ba byung dang*/ dri bzang sbyar ba'i chu dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su blugs pa dbang ldan nas g.yas skor du byug cing*/ oṃ me di nī badz+rī bha ba hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas/ rdo rje'i sa gzhir bsam/ yang khor yug kun tu byug cing | oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod pas srung ba'i 'khor lo rdzogs par bskyed/ dbus su gru bzhir byug cing*/ oṃ bhūm̐ bi mā na gā ra kū ṭā hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas rin po che'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs par bskyed nas/ lha'i gnas su dri'i thig le me tog gi tshom bu cung zad re bkod pa dang bcas pa so so'i gdan du bskyed la/ oṃ tām̐ badz+ra tā rā na maḥs dbus su me tog tshom bu bkod pa sgrol ma dang*/ oṃ āḥ.a mo gha sid+dhi na maḥs de nyid du tshom bu gcig bsnan pa don yod grub par bskyed/ de nas shar nas g.yas skor gyi rim pas/ oṃ oṃ bai ro tsa na na maḥs rnam par snang mdzad dang*/ oṃ trām̐ rat+na saṃ bha wa na maḥs rin chen 'byung ldan dang*/ oṃ hrīḥ.a mi tā bha na maḥs 'od dpag med/ oṃ hūm̐ a k+ṣo bh+ya na maḥs mi bskyod pa dang*/ yang shar lho nas rim pas/ oṃ lam̐ lo tsa ni na maḥs spyan ma dang*/ oṃ tām̐ rat+na tā ra na maḥs rin chen sgrol ma dang*/ oṃ pam̐ paṇ+ḍa ra ba si nī na maḥs gos dkar mo dang*/ oṃ mam̐ mā ma kī na maḥs mā ma kī dang*/ yang phyi'i shar lho nas rim pas/ oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra dhū pe na maḥs bdug spaus ma dang*/ oṃ trām̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe na maḥs me tog ma dang*/ oṃ hrīḥbadz+ra dī pe na maḥs mar me ma dang*/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra gan+dhe na maḥs dri ma dang*/
shar nas rim pas/ oṃ dzaḥbadz+ra aṃ gu sha na maḥs lcags kyu ma dang

| oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra pā sh+ya na maḥs zhags pa ma dang*/ oṃ baṃ badz+ra spo ṭa na maḥs lcags sgrog ma dang*/ oṃ hoḥbadz+ra ghan+ḍe na maḥs dril bu ma rnams bskyed la/ rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin byas nas/ phyi'i mchod pa rnams kyis rim pa bzhin mchod par bsam zhing*/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di | | sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ / bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod | | oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tā rā bha ga wa ti sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā la sogs pa rol mo'i bar gyis mchod nas/ gos zung du sbyar ba bzung la/ srab 'jam yang pa lha yi gos/ /mi phyed rdo rje'i sku la gsol/ /mi phyed mos pas bdag 'bul na/ /bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ tā rā bha ga wa ti sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra was+t+ra ya aḥs na bza' 'bul lo/ /phyi'i mchod pa'o// // de nas nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ mtheb srin gyi 'thor mas rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phul nas/ lce la myangs pas lus kyi lha mchod la/ chos skyong dang*/ 'jig rten skyong ba rnams la so so'i sngags kyis mchod pa ni/ nang bdud rtsi'i mchod pa'o/ /de nas bris pa la sogs pa'i 'dod yon lnga thogs pa'am/ so so'i phyag rgya bcas la/ yid kyis sprul pa'i 'dod yon rnams kyis rim pa bzhin du mchod par bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā rā bha wa ti sa pa ri wā ra/ zhes kun la sbyar la/ rū pa kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi ti āḥhūm̐ gis gzugs dang*/ shap+da tā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis sgra dang*/ gan+dha kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis dṛ dang*/ ra sa kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis ro dang*/ spar+ṣe kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis reg byas mchod pa ste/

mchod pa'o/ /de nas phyag 'tshal ba nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod pas bstod nas/ sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba bzhin gtor ma dang po bcom ldan 'das ma dang*/ gnyis pa chos skyong dang*/ gsum pa phyogs skyong dang*/ bzhi pa rgyal po chen po bzhi dang*/ lnga pa mkha' 'gro spyi'i gtor mas bsngos nas mkhyen par gsol ba'i phyir/ pus mo g.yas pa sa la btsugs nas spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ma lus phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /bcom ldan 'das ma'i dkyil 'khor bri/ /'dir ni sangs rgyas kun gshegs te/ / dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pas/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i zhal nas/ rdo rje 'dzin pa khyod ci dga' bar byos shig ces gnang ba byin par bsam mo/ /lha sta gon no/ /de nas bum pa lha'i grangs dang mnyam pa'am/ dbang gi bum pa lnga las thams cad pa ste drug gam/ bsdu na gnyis te/ gang grub pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang zhing mgul chings dang*/ kha rgyan dang bcas pa rnam rgyal gyi bum pa'i steng du dung chos bcud kyis gang ba'i steng du rdo rje gzungs thag dang bcas pa bshams la | bigh+nan+ta kṛ ta kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa ji ltar bshams pa ltar bskyed pa'i nang du so so'i gdan gyi steng du ā li phrag gnyis las zla ba/ kā li phrag gnyis las nyi ma/ bar du sa bon las phyag mtshan sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ de dag gcig tu 'dres pa las bum pa re rer lha re re'am/ gtso mo la 'khor gzhan gyis bskor ba dang*/ phyogs bzhi'i bum par rigs bzhi dang*/ las thams cad par bgegs mthar byed dam/ dbang gi bum par dkyil 'khor gyi lha bcu bdun dang*/ las thams cad par bgegs mthar byed bskyed de/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams ni sgrub thabs dang mthun la/

bgegs mthar byed ni slob ma yongs gzung gi skabs ltar ro/ /de rnams yan lag bzhi rdzogs su byas ba'i rjes la mchod cing bstod nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'phros pa'i sngags kyi phreng bas lha rnams kyi rgyud bskul bas so so'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar bsam zhing*/ sgrub thabs dang slob ma yongs su gzung ba'i skabs ltar sngags rnams ji ltar nus pa bzla'o/ / slar yang mchod cing bstod la/ dung chos kyi chu bum pa rnams su blugs pas lha rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi chur blta'o/ /bum pa sta gon no/ /de nas tshogs kyi yo byad byin gyis brlabs pas phyi nang gi lha rnams mchod nas/ lhag gtor gyi bar byas la/ 'das pa'i gtor ma bsrung ba'i phyir bzhag cing*/ gzhan rnams gtang ngo*/ /de nas gsang ba'i rdzas rnams bsgribs nas slob ma rnams khrus byas te | bla ma dang dkyil 'khor la phyag 'tshal nas 'khod pa la/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bdag nyid brgal zhing gzhan yang bsgral nas bla na med pa'i byang chub la gnas par bya ba'i phyir/ dbang bskur ba zhu'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa bskyed cing*/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul du bcug la/ me tog dang*/ bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar te | dga' chen khyod la bdag dga'a'o/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol//byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa'i/ /mgon po chen po bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems ni bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag ni bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni gzhug tu gsol | | zhes lan gsum du gsol ba 'debs su gzhug go /de nas rang gi snying ga nas spros pa'i 'od kyis slob ma rnams rang gi zhal gyi sgor bcug snying ga'i tām̐ gis sdig pa sbyangs nas mkhar bab pa sgrol mar bskyed la/ ye shes pa bstim zhing*/

dbang bskur nas don yod grub pas dbur brgyan pa spros nas rang gi gnas su 'khod pa la | bla mas gsol ba btab pa'i lan gdab pa'i phyir/ bu tshur theg pa chen po yi/ /gsang sngags tshul bzhin spyod pa ni/ khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /dus gsum 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /rdo rje gsang sngags 'di bsgoms pas/ /dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes / /gsang sngags spyod pa mnyam med de/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /bdud sde shin du mi bzad pa | | dpung dang bcas pa rab bcom nas/ /'jig rten rjes 'jug rtogs pa yis/ /'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir | | bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces brjod pas gsang sngags kyi che ba brjod cing*/ des bsgrub par khas blang ngo*/ /de nas slob ma la rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa'i phyir/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rangs | | sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir | | byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum du brjod du gzhug go /de nas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pa g.yas pa'i srin lag gis las thams cad pa'i bum pa'i chu blangs te/ slob ma'i dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying gar reg cing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas/ yi ge de dag tu gyur la/ mas yar reg cing 'bru gsum brjod pas/ rdo rje dang*/

pad+ma dang*/ 'khor lor gyur par bsam mo/ /yang yas mar rim pa bzhin reg cing 'bru gsum brjod pas/ phyag mtshan de dag la/ yig 'bru de dag gis mtshan par bsam pa la/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs nas/ byin gyis brlabs par bsam mo/ /de dag la me tog la sogs pa mchod pa lngas mchod nas/ deng nas bzung nas bu khyod kyis/ /'khor ba'i nyes pas mi gos par/ /mchod pa kun dang ldan par ni/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig | ces brjod do/ /de nas tshom bu gcig pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du sor brgyad dam bcu gnyis kyi tshad dang ldan pa'i so shing gser las grub par bsams la/ oṃ dze hwa badz+ra saṃ war+dha ni zhes pa'i sngags kyis byin pa/ slob ma'i sos bldad de sdig pa thams cad skyugs par bsams la/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su dor ba'i rtse mo shar du phyogs pas zhi ba dang*/ byang du rgyas pa dang*/ nub tu dbang dang*/ lhor drag po dang*/ steng du mkha' la spyod pa dang*/ 'og tu rin po che'i gter dang*/ mtshams rnams su phyogs pas dngos grub phra mo rnams 'grub par lung bstan no | | de nas oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dhas+sarba dharmāḥsarba pā paṃ ni tsa saṃ sho dha ya sarba bi kalpa a pa na ya hūm̐ phaṭa kyi sngags kyis las thams cad pa'i chu blud pas sdig pa dang*/ dri ma thams cad sbyang ngo*/ /de nas skud pa dmar po'am ser po lus tshad dang mnyam pa sum bltab tu bkal zhing rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum byas pa hūm̐ las rdo rje srad bur byin gyis brlabs pa la ye shes kyi skud pa spyan drangs pa bstim la/ yi ge bcu pas bsngags pa slob ma skyes pa rnams kyi dpung pa g.yon pa dang*/ bud med kyi g.yas par yi ge brgya pa brjod cing bcings pas bsrungs nas/ lag pa g.yas par ku sha'i chun po chung ba dhīḥdang*/ g.yon par che ba haḥzhes brjod nas byin la/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams/

/u dum wā ra'i me tog bzhin/ / brgya lam du ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang na ma ི 'byung srid/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gis sems can mnyam med don/ /mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus/ /bskal pa bye ba du ma ru/ / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*/ /'gro don mnyam med byed par 'gyur / /gzhan yang theg pa chen po yi/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ khyed rnams der ni dong bas na/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i 'bras thob par/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur/ /des na bu yis brtson par gyis/ /zhes brjod cing don bshad de/ spro ba brtan por bya'o/ /de nas ku sha chung ba sngas dang*/ che ba stan du bcug la/ mgo byang ngam shar du bstan nas gzhogs g.yas pa 'og tu bcug ste/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa ces zlos bzhin pas lha dang bla ma yid la byed cing nyol la/ rmi lam du mthong ba rnams nangs par nga la smros shig ces bsgos nas so so'i gnas su gtong ngo*/ /nangs par rmi lam bshad pa'i tshe mi dge ba mthong na chos thams cad stong pa nyid yid la byed pa dang/ sangs rgyas spyan gyi bsgom pa dang*/ bzlas pas zhi bar bya'o/ /dge bar mthong na spro ba bskyed do/ /de nas bla mas me tog tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor mchod cing bstod nas/ oṃ badz+ro tiṣ+ṭha'i sngags dang*/ phyag rgyas nam mkha' la bteg la/ mchod cing bstod nas/ slob ma'i bya ba ma rdzogs kyi bar du bzhugs su gsol lo/ /me tog tshom bu la sogs pa las kyi rjes rnams bsdus nas/ gtor ma'i mgron rnams gshegs su gsol la | gtor ma'ang gtang ngo*/ /nam mkha' la bteg pa'i lha mchod pa'i phyir/ mchod pa gsar pa bshams la/ rang nyid nyal ba'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas nyal bar bya'o/ /sta gon gyi cho ga'o// // de nas nangs par ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis langs la/ dag pa gsum dran par byas na/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/

oṃ badz+ra shud+dhaḥ sarba dharmā badz+ra shud+dho3 haṃ/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhas+sarba dharmā yo ga shud+dho3 haṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi ba byung dang*/ dri bzang gis legs par byugs la/ cha chen bcu drug sgo rkyang pa/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad dang*/ lha snam ste/ 'phar ma gnyis dang ldan pa'i rkyang pa dang*/ bskor ba'i las kyi thig gdab par bya ste/ mthong ba brgyud pa las shes par bya'o/ /de'i steng du drang bar bde zhing mdog phun sum tshogs pa'i rdul tshon bdud rtsi'i ri lus sbags pa/ ljang gu la aḥbris pa dbus dang | dkar po la oṃ bris pa shar dang*/ ser po la trāṃ bris pa lho dang | dmar po la hrīḥbris pa nub dang*/ sngon po la hūm̐ bris pa byang du bkod pa'i steng du srin bal la sogs pa las byas pa'i srad bu sbom phra dang*/ ring thung dang*/ 'jur mdud med pa lnga sgril du bkal ba dkyil 'khor gyi nyis 'gyur gyi tshad dang mnyam pa rnams tshon sna lngas bsgyur la bzhag go /de'i mdun du mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma bshams pa la phyogs pas slob dpon shar du 'dug la/ sgrol ma'i rnal 'byor rdzogs par bsgoms te/ thig tshon rnams bigh+nān+ta kṛta kyis bsang | swa bhā was sbyangs pa'i ngang las sa bon so so las rigs lnga yum lnga dang bcas pa bskyed | ye shes pa gzhug dbang bskur/ rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan pa la phyi nang gis mchod/ don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /la sogs pas bstod/de dag snyoms par zhugs pa las byung ba'i thig tshon du gyur par bsam zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sū traṃ ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi shar du bltas te langs la/ thig skud rnams blangs te g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis thig sna 'dzin la bgegs mthar byed kyi nga rgyal 'dzin pa la rim pas gtad de/ gnyis char gyis dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ zhes brjod do/ /de nas/ phan tshun rjes su rtogs pa ste/

/chos kun phan tshun rjes su 'gro/ /chos rnams thams cad shin tu yang*/ /kun tu 'gro bar chos kun brjod/ /ces brjod cing lnga ka lhan cig tu bsgril nas rdo rje la dkris te/ nang mchod kyis gtor ro/ /de nas slob dpon shar bltas slob ma nub/ /tshangs thig dang po gdab par bya/ /slob dpon lhor 'dug slob ma byang*/ /gnyis pa yang ni gdab par bya/ /me yi phyogs su gnas pa yis/ /byang bltas shar gyi thig gdab bya/ /rlung gnas lhor bltas nub thig gdab/ /de nyid las ni byang ngos gdab/ /mer gnas lho phyogs thig bya zhing*/ /de nas rlung gi phyogs su bya/ /bden bral gnas pas dbang ldan par// rim pas ji bzhin gdab par bya/ /de'i tshe/ nam mkha' gang ba'i sangs rgyas rnams | | 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags pas/ khyed rnams 'dir ni gshegs gsol bar/ /thig skud sgra yis bskul bar bgyi/ zhes pa dang*/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sū traṃ ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing*/ thig chen brgyad/ 'og dang steng cha gnyis su btab pas gzhal yas khang gi rnam par grub par bltas nas/ shar nub tu gnas pas rdo rje la thig skud dkris pa la bdud rtsi gtor nas/ oṃ badz+ra be ge kra ma ho/ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas ye shes kyi thig rnams nam mkha'

la bteg nas rdo rje dril bu dkur 'dzin pas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su song la/ 'gying ba dang bcas pas phyogs bzhir mig shin tu gdangs bas blta zhing*/ hi zhes brjod pas sgo bzhi bye bar bsam mo/ /de nas slob dpon dbus nas shar du bltas te/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya tsi tra ma ti kra ma hūm̐ gis rdul tshon rnams bsngags nas g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa'i nang nas rim pa bzhin ljang gu/ dkar po/ ser po/ dmar po/ sngon po rnams sgo logs kyi tshad dang mnyam pa/ sbom phra dang*/ 'dres pa dang*/ bar chad la sogs pa'i nyes pa dang bral ba g.yas skor du bri zhing*/ 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni rab grol byed/ /bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma yi/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bri bar bya/ /zhes pa dang*/ gong gi sngags brjod cing bris la/ rigs lnga'i ngo bo bltas nas mchod de/ ka pā las kha bcad pa'i steng du thig skud kyis dkris pa'i rdo rje bzhag la/ hūm̐ gi sngags kyis dbus kyi phur bu phyung ba'i bu gar sngar gyi rim pas rdul tshon rnams kyis dgang ngo*/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba ser po/ 'dab ma mdzes tshon/ mu khyud dmar po la ral gri'i phreng ba bkod pa/ lha snam dmar po/ sgo bzhi shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang sngon po/ grwa bzhir bum pa gnyis gnyis te bum pa brgyad/ rta babs dang*/ 'dod yon dang*/ pha gu dang*/ dra ba dra phyed dang*/ mda' yab la sogs pa rnams dkyil 'khor spyi dang mthun par byas pa la mtshan ma dgod pa ni | dbus su ut+pa la ljang gu la gnas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje shar dang*/ shar lhor 'khor lo/ lho dang*/ lho nub tu rin po che/ nub dang*/ nub byang du pad+ma/ byang dang*/ byang shar du rdo rje dang*/ lha snam gyi shar lhor spos khang | lho nub tu me tog nub byang du mar me/ byang shar du dri'i dung chos/

shar sgor lcags kyu/ lho sgor zhags pa/ nub sgor lcags sgrog byang sgor dril bu rnams so so'i kha dog dang mthun par dgod do/ /rta babs kyi gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje | gzhal yas khang gi gzhi nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ljang gu/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma mdzes tshon/ de'i phyi rol du mu khyud la phyogs skyong ba rnams dang*/ rgyal po chen po bzhi'i mtshan ma rnams so so'i thad sor bkod pa'i phyi rol du rdo rje'i phreng ba dang*/ me'i khor yug bri'o/ /de'i phyi rol du mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma rnams kyis bskor zhing | bla re dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan la sogs pas dkyil 'khor gyi gnas nye bar brgyan zhing mdzes par bya'o/ /de nas phyi dro'i dus kyi tshe/ slob dpon sgrub pa'i grogs dang bcas pa 'khod de/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma btang ba nas mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa'i bar sta gon ltar bya'o/ /de nas las thams cad pa'i chu'am nang mchod kyis dkyil 'khor la gtor zhing*/ bgegs mthar byed kyi sngags kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor sgrub thabs ltar bskyed cing*/ khor yug la phyogs skyong bcu dang*/ rgyal po chen po bzhi bskyed la bdag gis bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor dang yang gnyis su med par bsres nas/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs la sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bzhugs pa la mchod nas bstim mo/ /slar yang ye shes pa gzhug pa dang*/ dbang bskur nas rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab pa sgrub thabs ltar byas la/ so so'i sngags lan bdun bdun brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas bdag nyid gtso mo'i thugs ka nas sgrol ma nyid dam/ don yod grub pa'i nga rgyal gyis bye nas shar du gnas pas dkyil 'khor la mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa dang*/ gtor ma'i bar sta gon gyi skabs ltar byas nas/ dkyil 'khor blta bar mi dbang ba'i 'byung po rnams la dkyil 'khor gy-i khang pa'i phyi rol du gtor ma bshams la rdo rje gnod sbyin la sogs pa'i sngags dang*/

phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs la/ phyi rol pa'i 'byung po rnams la byin par bsam zhing*/ oṃ de wa/ nā ga yak+ṣa/ gan+dha r+bha/ a su ra/ ga ru ḍa/ kin+na ra/ ma ho ra ga ma nu ṣ+ya/ a ma nu ṣ+ya/ sarba bhū te bh+yo na maḥ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga ṇa khaṃ gri h+ne daṃ ba liṃ te swā hā/ zhes gsum mam bdun gyis phul la/ dkyil 'khor chen po blta bar mi dbang ba'i 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la | sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par dengs shig ces brjod la rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas gtor ma gtang ngo*// // de nas dkyila'akhor gyi drung shar phyogs su 'dug nas/ ting nge 'dzin gyis sgo bzhi phye bar bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra dha rod+gha ṭa ya badz+ra sa ma ya swā hā/ zhes brjod nas/ dbang bskur ba'i cho ga rnams gtso mos mdzad cing*/ dbang rdzas gtod pa la sogs pa'i las rnams de'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i bgegs mthar byed kyis mdzad par bsam zhing*/ slob ma la ji tsam dbang bskur ba rnams rang gis blang bar bya'o/ /bdag nyid 'jug pa'o// // de nas slob ma thogs pa med par 'jug par bya ba'i phyir rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas | chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ / gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun du byung*/ /de bzhin nyid las nges par byung*/ /bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor du/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma ni/ /kun gyis dri med mthong bar shog /ces lan gsum brjod do//de nas tshogs kyi yo byad kyis phyi nang gi lha rnams mchod pa lhag gtor gyi bar byas nas | gsang ba'i rdzas rnams bsgrib pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor yol bas bcad nas slob ma rnams khrus byas te phyag 'tshal nas rim pas 'khod pas dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ sta gon gyi skabs ltar/ dga' chen khyod la bdag dga'o/

/ zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsol ba lan gsum btab la/ oṃ a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis gdong g.yogs bcing zhing*/ me tog gi phreng ba gtad la/ bighan ta kṛta kyi sngags dang las thams cad pa'i bum pa'i chus bsangs nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi 'thung du bcug pas byin gyis brlabs la/ skad cig gis bgegs mthar byed du bskyed do/ /de'i snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa bsgoms la | bla mas rdo rje ∶ snying gar (《 lu 》- snying gar ) bzhag cing*/ gnyis kas/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi/ zhes brjod la/ slob dpon gyis/ su ra ti sa ma ya ho/ sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*/ dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyise/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no/ /hūm̐ zhes pas gsang bar gdams nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi sgo ma bzhi'i thugs ka nas rang dang 'dra ba'i pho nya spros pas slob ma rnams dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs par bsam zhing*/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes brjod nas las kyi rdo rjes slob ma khrid nas bla ma dang*/ dkyil 'khor la lan gsum bskor ba'am/ bskor bar mos la/ ha ha he he/ zhes brjod cing*/ yol ba'i nang du gzhug go /de nas slob ma rnams kyis dpral bar thal mo sbyar nas/ na ma ste hūm̐ gis dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i sku dang*/ mgrin par thal mo sbyar nas na mo mi hūm̐ gis gsung dang*/ snying gar thal mo sbyar nas na mo nā ma hūm̐ gis thugs la phyag 'tshal du gzhug go /de nas dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/

/la sogs pas rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa lan gsum byed du bcug nas smon pa dang*/ 'jug pa'i byang chub kyi sems brtan pa'i gsang sngags kyi rigs lnga'i dam tshig dang sdom pa'i yan lag thams cad gzung ba'i bsam pas/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba ni/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas ni/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med | | dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*//dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*/ /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan por bdag gis gzung*/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas bdag gis gzung*/ /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la | | rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog rnal 'byor gyi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la | | nyin re zhing ni dus drug du/ /zang zing mi 'jigs dam chos dang*/ /byams pa rin chen rigs mchog gi /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum//dam chos so sor gzung bar bgyi/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ / dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung | | ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi/

/dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*/ /sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod/ /ces lan gsum gyis sdom pa gzung ngo*/ /de nas rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di/ /ma mthong snod dang mi ldan pa/ /su la'ang ston par ma byed cig / ces yang dag par gdams nas/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi blud la/ 'di ni rdo rje dam tshig yin/ /srungs shig ma bsrungs sreg par byed/ /bsrungs na dngos grub ster byed ba'i/ /bdud rtsi 'di ni myang bar gyis/ /oṃ pañca a mṛ ta u da ka ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥzhes brjod nas mna' chu blud do/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis rlobs shig bcom ldan 'das sgrol ma bdag la dbab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab bo/ /de nas slob ma la chos thams cad rmi lam dang sgyu ma ltar shes pas rang gi lus dang*/ longs spyod la ma chags pa'i blo bskyed la/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas yi ge a dmar po dpag tu med pa 'phros nas slob ma'i lus la thim pas sdig pa dang sgrib pa sbyangs nas mya ngan med pa'i sgrol mar gyur pa ni sku mdog dmar mo sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ phyag dang po gnyis spyi bor thal mo sbyar zhing | g.yas kyi gnyis pas ral gri dang*/ g.yon gyi gnyis pas mya ngan med pa'i shing 'dzin pa bskyed pa'i spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje las 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad sgrol ma'i skur gyur pa sna tshogs rdo rje la zhugs shing slob ma'i lus la thim par dpon slob gnyis char gyis bsgoms la/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re tsit+ta maṇ+ḍal badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes brjod cing gu gul gyis bdug rol mo'i sgra drag tu byas pas ye shes phab nas spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ras brtan par bya'o/ /yang rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/

sangs rgyas kun dngos rje btsun ma/ khyod kyi snying la yang dag zhugs/ /rtag tu yi dam lha yin gyis/ / tshul 'di smra bar ma byed cig /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs | | zhes pas ye shes zhugs kyi dbang ma thob pa la mi smra bar gdams nas slar rdo rje bzhag la/ nga ni 'phags ma sgrol ma ste/ /nga yis bsgo ba'i las gyis la/ /ma mos brnyas par ma byed cig /gal te khyod kyis brnyas na ni/ /dam tshig 'di yis sreg par byed/ /tsha ba chen po'i gnas su sreg /ces bla ma'i bka' nyan par bsgo'o/ /de nas bla mas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /bcom ldan sgrol ma'i grol khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dang*/ /bsod nams rim pa'ang de bzhin shog /rigs ni gang gi snod du gyur | | 'di la bsod nams ci yod pa/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog | ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ slob ma rnams kyis me tog gi phreng ba thogs te | dkyil 'khor gyi sgo shar nas gdong g.yogs dang bcas te | dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi bar snang la bltas pas dkar por mthong na zhi ba | ser po rgyas pa/ dmar po dbang*/ sngon po drag po/ ljang gu dang*/ khra bo phrin las sna tshogs 'grub par lung bstan nas/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes brjod pas me tog phul ba gang la phog pa de khyod kyi lhag pa'i lha yin no/ /zhes brjod nas | blangs pa spyi bor bzhag ste/ oṃ pra tī gri h+na swa mi maṃ sa twa ma hā ba la oṃ zhes brjod nas/ rang bzhin dag pa bdag med lus/ /dpa' bo dang ni dpa' mo'i gnas | | dri med rang bzhin dkyil 'khor 'di/ /bu khyod kyis ni blta bar gyis | | oṃ badz+ra ne tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa la hrīḥprāṃ/ zhes brjod nas/ dkyil 'khor bstan la/ gtso mo nas brtsams te lha so so dang*/
