dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par bstan no/ / dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'o/ /de nas dbang blang ba'i phyir maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ bsam gyis mi khyab dam chos snod/ /dbang bskur dam pa mdzad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba 'debs su bcug nas/ slob ma rin po che'i khri'i steng du sgrol ma ljang gur dmigs pa'i steng na rin po che'i gdugs | nye 'khor thams cad mchod pas yongs su gang ba la mchod la/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i sangs rgyas rigs lngas dbang bskur/yum bzhis rdo rje'i glu len/ byang chub sems dpas bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad brjod | khro bos bgegs bskrad/ mchod pa'-i lha mos mchod pa mdzad par bsam zhing | dngos su phun sum tshogs pa la sogs pa'i bkra shis brjod la/ me tog gtor ba ni sngon du 'gro ba shis pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas slob ma dang*/ bum pa rnams kyi chu rnams rnam rgyal du bsdus pa swa bhā was mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las mi bskyod pa/ mā ma kī dang bcas par bskyed pa'i gnas gsum du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ bkod/ ye shes pa bstim/ dbang rjas la dbang bskur/ mi bskyod pa'i rgyas btab pa snyoms par zhugs pa las byung ba'i bum pa'i chur blta/ bla ma dang dbang gi lha rnams la bdag la chu'i dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/

ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni | | lha rnams kyis ni dbang bskur ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin 'dir ni dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra ā dar+ṣa dz+nya na a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma rnams dag mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan pa la/ mchod pa lngas mchod nas/ mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin chu'i dbang thob pas zhe sdang dag me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi ngo bo mi bskyod par gyur zhes rtogs pa bskyed do/ /de nas slob ma rnams dang*/ dbu rgyan mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las ām̐ las rin po che ām̐ gis mtshan pa las rin chen 'byung ldan/ rin chen sgrol ma dang bcas par bskyed pa'i sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ye shes pa bstim/ dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rgyas btab pa snyoms par zhugs pa las byung ba'i dbu rgyan du blta'o/ /de nas bla ma dang dbang gi lha rnams la bdag la dbu rgyan gyi dbang bskur du gsol/zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis rab bsngags pa'i/ /cod pan dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ta dz+nya na rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñca māṃ | zhes gsung zhing dbu rgyan bcing*/ bum pa'i chus kyang dbang bskur/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan pa la mchod pas mchod nas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rang bzhin dbu rgyan gyi dbang bskur bas/ nga rgyal dang ser sna dag mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo rin chen 'byung ldan du gyur zhes rtogs pa bskyed do/ /de nas slob ma dang*/ rdo rje mi dmigs pa'i ngang las dz+rīṃ las pad+ma dz+rīṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od dpag med gos dkar mo dang bcas par bskyed pa'i sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa bstim/ dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ 'od dpag med kyi rgyas btab pa snyoms par zhugs pa las byung ba'i rdo rjer blta | bla ma dang*/

dbang gi lha rnams la bdag la rdo rje'i dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ra pra t+ya be k+ṣa dz+nya na badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ zhes gsung zhing lag pa g.yas par rdo rje sbyin/ bum pa'i chus kyang dbang bskur/ 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan pa la mchod pas mchod nas 'od dpag med kyi rang bzhin rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas 'dod chags dag so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo 'od dpag med du gyur zhes rtogs pa bskyed do/ /de nas slob ma dang dril bu mi dmigs pa'i ngang las kham̐ las ral gri kham̐ gis mtshan pa las don yod grub pa sgrol ma dang bcas par bskyed pa'i sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa bstim/ dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ don yod grub ∶ pa'i rgyas btab (《 lu 》 dbu brgyan ) pa snyoms par zhugs pa las byung ba'i dril bur blta/ bla ma dang dbang gi lha rnams la/ bdag la dril bu'i dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ kri tā nuṣ+ṭhā na badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ zhes gsung zhing*/ lag pa g.yon par dril bu sbyin/ bum pa'i chus kyang dbang bskur/ don yod grub pas dbur brgyan pa la mchod pas mchod nas/ don yod grub pa'i rang bzhin dril bu'i dbang bskur bas phrag dog dag bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo don yod grub par gyur zhes rtogs pa bskyed do/ /de nas slob ma mi dmigs pa'i ngang las oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las/rnam par snang mdzad sangs rgyas spyan dang bcas par bskyed pa'i sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa bstim/ bla ma dang dbang gi lha rnams la/ bdag la ming gi dbang bskur du gsol | zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ra dharma dhā tu dz+nyā na badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta | kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o zhes me tog gang la phog pa'i rigs kyi ming gdags/ bum pa'i chus kyang dbang bskur/

rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan pa la mchod pas mchod nas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin ming gi dbang bskur bas gti mug dag chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo rnam par snang mdzad du gyur zhes rtogs pa bskyed do/ /de ltar khyod kyis rig pa'i dbang lnga thob pas phung po lnga sangs rgyas lngar gyur pa'i phyir bdag dang snang ba thams cad sangs rgyas rigs lnga'i ngo bor shes par gyis shig ces brjod do/ /rig pa'i dbang lnga'o// // de nas bla mas bdug spos la sogs pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod nas | slob ma mi dmigs pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du tām̐ las sgrol mar bskyed la me tog gi phreng ba snyim par 'dzin du bcug nas/ slob dpon sgrol ma'i nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i thugs ka'i tām̐ gi mtha' mar 'khor ba'i sngags las sngags kyi phreng ba 'phros pas slob ma'i snying ga'i tām̐ gi mtha' ma (《 lu 》 mar ) bskor bar gnyis kas bsgom zhing*/ yi ge bcu pa lan gsum rjes zlos su bcug pa'i mthar/ bcom ldan bdag la byin brlabs nas/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab/ bla mas/ rig sngags 'di la byin lags kyis/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes brjod la me tog phreng ba spyi bor bzhag go /de nas lag par rdo rje gtad nas/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ zhes brjod nas dbu rgyan dang*/ dar dpyangs la sogs pa'i rgyan dang*/ stod g.yogs dmar po dang*/ smad g.yogs kha dog sna tshogs bskon la | oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ a bh-i ṣiñca māṃ/ zhes brjod pas bsrungs nas/ bu khyod la rigs sngags 'di rjes su gtad kyis/ khyod kyis rdzogs pa'i byang chub ma thob kyi bar du rig sngags 'di'i gzi brjid dang*/ byin gyis brlabs kyis nyams par ma byed cig ces bsgo ba ni lha dang*/

rig sngags rjes su gnang ba'o/ /de nas slob dpon gyis snam sbyar gyon nas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya slob ma'i spyi bor gtugs la/ bu khyod 'khor los dbang bskur gyis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid yin/ /srid gsum ma lus sgrol mdzad ma/ /bde bar gshegs pas lung bstan no/ /kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa/ sa 'og sa steng*/ sa bla gsum du bhur+bhu wa swaḥ gang la ngas lung bstan pa 'di la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu byang chub chen por lung ston par mdzad de/ sngags 'di dang phyag rgya 'di'i mthu yin no/ / zhes lung bstan no/ /de nas/ khams gsum bdag po rgyal srid che/ /dpal ldan yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bdud kyi sde rnams bcom zin gyis/ khyod ni grong khyer mchog tu zhugs/ /oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re sid+dhi sa ma ya s+t+waṃ swa bhā wa a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ zhes brjod nas dbugs dbyung ngo*/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ mtshan ma med par 'gro ba'i don/ /gang dag bdag gis byed nus pa/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang bskur che/ /dpa' bo chen po bdag la stsol/ / zhes lan gsum gsol ba 'debs su bcug nas/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i dbang stegs kyi steng na gnas pa'i slob ma swa bhā was mi dmigs pa'i ngang las rin po che'i khri/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng na hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas rdo rje snyems ma sngon mo gri gug dang*/ thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par bskyed pa'i sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa bstim/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi ngo bo rdo rje lag pa g.yas par sbyin zhing*/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/

khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zungs | | rdo rje sems dpa'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ e ṣa dha ra yā mi hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ zhes brjod do/ / de nas/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che | | kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o/ /zhes de kho na nyid brjod nas/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing*/ lan gsum gsor te snying gar 'dzin du bcug pas thugs kyi dam tshig bskyed/ de nas/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zungs/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /ces pas dril bu g.yon du byin nas | aḥsrid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems ldan pa | | srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur/ /zhes de kho na nyid brjod nas/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe aḥ zhes brjod cing*/ dkrol du bcug pas gsung gi dam tshig bskyed/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /zungs shig rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis/ zhes gnang ba byin nas/ yum la 'khyud pa'i tshul du bya zhing*/ lha'i sku phyag rgya'i dam tshig tu bskyed pa la/ srid pa'i bde ba shin tu chung*/ /sdug bsngal chen po dag bya'i phyir/ /shin tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs/ /dam tshig 'di ni rtag tu zungs/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la/ /ci 'dod par ni bsten bzhin du/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lha sbyor bas | | bdag dang gzhan la mchod par gyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ /'da' ba ru ni mi mdzad pa'i/ /phyag rgya dam tshig ces su bsgrags/ /yid kyi lus ni brtan phyir ro/ /zhes phyag rgya'i dam tshig rgyas par bshad nas/ bum pa'i chus kyang dbang bskur/

mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan pa la dbang gi lha dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swā hā/ zhes gsung zhing me tog gi char phab nas khams gsum gyi chos kyi rgyal por mnga' phul bar bsam mo | | rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ngo*/ /de nas chos 'chad pa'i rjes su gnang ba sbyin pa'i phyir/ 'khor lo bris pa'i khri la slob ma bzhag nas/ lag pa g.yas par dung*/ g.yon par dril bu/ lag ngar nyid kyi steng du pu sti rnams/ oṃ badz+ra dharma tsakra a bhi ṣe ka ta a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ zhes pas byin nas/ slob ma'i snying gar 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa bkod pa la ye shes kyi 'khor lo bstim/ bum pa'i chus kyang dbang bskur nas 'od dpag med kyi rgyas btab la/ khyod kyis the tshom dogs med par/ /yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bla med pa/ /lus can kun la bskor bar gyis/ / zhes brjod/ slob mas kyang dung 'bud/ dril bu dkrol/ chos kyi 'khor lo tshul bzhin du bskor bar sems bskyed pa ni chos bshad pa'i rjes gnang ngo*/ /rnal 'byor de nyid shes pa yis/ /mi bya ba ni gang yang med/ /dpa' bo chen po nga yi bkas | | 'dod yon lnga la spyad par gyis/ /deng nas bzung nas bu khyod kyis/ / lus dang srog la mi phangs par/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*/ /'gro ba'i don ni dpag med byos/ /sems can gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /rten cing 'brel ba'i chos dang ldan/ khams gsum de ltar shes nas ni/ /sems can don ni mtshungs med byos/ /zhes brjod pa ni kun tu spyod pa dang*/ sems can gyi don byed pa'i rjes su gnang ba'o/ /de ltar/ chu/ cod pan/ rdo rje/ dril bu/ ming*/ lha dang*/ sngags sbyin pa/ lung bstan pa/ dbugs dbyung ba/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang*/ chos bshad pa'i rjes gnang*/ kun tu spyod pa dang*/ sems can gyi don byed pa'i rjes gnang ste bum pa'i dbang bcu gcig go

/phal cher bum pa la gnas pas/ / bum pa'i dbang zhes brjod pa yin/ /phyir mi ldog dang rjes su gnang | | rdo rje slob dpon dbang yin no/ /nyon mongs dri ma bkrus pa dang*/ /sa ni dang po thob par byed/ /ces shes par bya'o/ /de nas gsang ba'i dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal dang | phyi nang gi mchod pas bla ma la mchod nas/ slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /gsang spyod thabs dang ldan pa yi/ /shes rab chen po'i snod 'gyur phyir/ /dbang bskur chen po mdzad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum du gsol ba gdab/ bla mas/ gsang spyod thabs dang ldan pa yi/ /ye shes bdud rtsi dri ma med/ /bdud rtsi dam pa myang ba yi/ /dbang bskur 'di la khyod spro'am/ /zhes dri/ slob mas tshig snga ma rnams kyi mthar bdag spro'o zhes lan gdab/ de nas a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐ gis slob ma'i gdong g.yogs/ dngos sam ye shes kyi phyag rgya mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bla ma la dbul bar bsam zhing*/ slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /lha mo 'di ni khyad par can/ /yon tan mtha' dag ldan pa ste/ /gsang spyod thabs kyi sbyor ba las/ /gsang ba'i dbang bskur mdzad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum du gsol ba gdab/ de nas bla ma don yod grub pa dang*/ phyag rgya rje btsun ma sgrol mar dmigs pa'i mkha' pad+ma dang*/ gsang ba rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs nas gnyis ka'i gnas gsum du yi ge gsum dang*/ lte bar swā dang*/ brla gnyis la hā bkod la/ rang gi lus kyi bde bas de bzhin gshegs par mchod cing slaub ma la gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba'i phyir snyoms par 'jug snyam pa'i 'du shes kyis mnyam par sbyor ba las byung ba'i bde ba chen po'i sgras sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs la tshangs bug nas zhugs/ thugs kar 'od du zhu ba'i thig le sbyor mtshams nas byung ba slob ma'i lce la bzhag cing*/ dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ /dam tshig 'di ni ngo mtshar che/

khams lnga yi ni ros gang ba/ /bde ba chen po myang bar gyis | | 'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur | | byang chub sems ni yid 'ong bas/ /de bzhin bu khyod dbang bskur ro | | zhes brjod/ slob mas/ a ho ma hā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod cing mid pas/ lus thams cad byang chub kyi sems kyis gang*/ ngag gi dri ma thams cad dag nas 'od dpag med du gyur par bltas la gdong g.yogs dbye'o/ /'di ni gsang ba'i dbang yin te/ /sa bcu'i ye shes thob par byed/ /de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du bla ma la maṇ+ḍal dang*/ phyi nang gi mchod pas mchod nas/ slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /gsang spyod thabs dang ldan pa yi/ /ye shes chen po'i snod 'gyur phyir/ /shes rab ye shes dbang bskur gsol || zhes lan gsum gsol ba 'debs su bcug pa la/ gsang spyod thabs dang ldan pa yi/ /shes rab ye shes dri ma med/ /bde ba dam pa myong ba yi/ / dbang bskur 'di la khyod spro'am/ /zhes dri/ slob mas kyang*/ tshig snga ma dag gi mthar/ bdag spro'o zhes lan gdab bo/ /de nas slob ma'i gdong g.yogs pa don yod grub par bskyed nas yongs su sbyangs pa'i rig ma dngos su bzhag pa'am/ yid kyis mdun du dmigs pa/ sgrol mar bskyed la/ lha mo 'di ni khyad par che/ /bde ba mtha' yas ster byed pa/ /blangs nas rnam pa thams cad du/ /bu yis bla med mchod par gyis/

/zhes brjod la gtad do/ /de nas rig mas/ byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /bu yis de ring za nus sam/ /rigs lnga dag las byung ba yi/ /phyag rgya dad pas mchod nus sam/ /bshang gci khu ba rak+ta sogs/ /'di nyid du ni za nus sam/ /nga yi gsang ba'i pad+ma yis/ /bde ba'i myu gu bskyed pa ste | khyod kyis rtag tu mchod nus sam/ /zhes dris pa'i lan du/ ji skad bshad pa'i dam tshigs (《 lu 》 tshig ) rnams/ /lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro/ /lha mo'i pad+ma mchod par bgyi | | gsang ba'i rdzas la bdag spro'o/ /zhes lan btab nas/ snga ma ltar mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs nas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du bya snyam pa'i 'dun pas snyoms par zhugs la/ ngag gi 'dren pa dang*/ lus kyi 'phrul 'khor gyis byang chub kyi sems kyi 'gyu ba bkag nas bde ba bsgoms pas dga' ba dang*/ mchog dga' dang*/ dga' bral gyi dga' ba dang*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i ye shes bskyed la de'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag go / de nas rig ma'i lag pa g.yon pa slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag nas/ nga dang rdo rje slob dpon dang*/ /mched dang lcam dral thams cad dang*/ khams gsum sems can ma lus la/ /ma mos brnyas pa ma byed cing*/ /gzhan yang dam tshig spyod pa rnams| |rtag tu khyod kyis bsrung bar gyis/ /deng nas bzung nas bu khyod kyis// ji srid byang chub ma thob par/ /sems can kun gyi don rnams ni/ /rtag tu rmi lam bzhin du byos/ /zhes brjod par bsam mo/ /de nas gdong g.yogs phye la | shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob bo/ /zhes brda sprad do/ /'di ni shes rab ye shes kyi | | dbang yin mi shes kun sel cing*/ /bde gshegs sku gsum thob byed pa | | rdo rje 'chang gis yongs su gsungs/ /zhes shes par bya'o/ /de nas dbang bzhi pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal dang*/ mchod pa phul nas/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyong ba/

/de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gyis/ / gtso bo bdag la bka' drin skyobs/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ slob ma'i gdong g.yogs shing*/ skyil mo krung dang*/ mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya bcas te | sngar gyi shes rab ye shes kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyun bsgom du bcug la/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*/ /rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu/ /rdul bral mthar sbyin zhi ba nyid/ khyod rang yang ni de yi pha/ /zhes brjod pas mtshon bya chos nyid de bzhin nyid du ngo sprad la mnyam par 'jog tu gzhug go /de nas gdong g.yogs phye la/ dbang bzhi pa thob bo zhes brda sprad do// // de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa byas te/ phyogs skyong ba dang*/ rgyal po chen po bzhi la gtor ma phul nas/ bla ma dang*/ dpa' bo dang | rnal 'byor ma rnams tshogs kyis mchod nas/ bla ma la yon phul nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha la 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab la/ yi ge brgya pas cho ga lhag chad kha bskangs te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba dang*/ smon lam rgya chen po btab la/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /ces lan gsum gyis bzod par gsol la/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pa dang*/ yi ge brgya pa'i mthar tā re bha ga wa tī sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra muḥ zhes brjod pas dkyil 'khor gyi ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs dam tshig pa rang la bsdus nas gtor ma'i mgron rnams gshegs su gsol te/ rol mo dang bcas pas gtor ma gtang ngo*/ /de nas oṃ gi li gi li swā hā dang*/ a kā ro'i sngags brjod pas dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa bshig la/ rdul tshon rnams legs par bsdus nas rol mo dang bcas pas rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu bor dor la las kyi rjes bsdu'o/

/mjug gi cho ga'o/ /gzhan la dbang bskur ba'i tshul de nyid rang gis blangs pas bdag nyid 'jug pa'i cho gar yang 'gyur ba nyid do/ /de ltar rje btsun sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang rab bskur ba'i cho ga bshad pa yi/ /dge ba gang des bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ /sgrol ma'i dpal gyis rnam par 'byor gyur cig /rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i cho ga 'di ni/ dad pa dang shes rab gsal ba dpon mo go go chen zhes bya bas rgyang ring po nas bskul ba'i ngor/ slob dpon nyi ma sbas pa'i gzhung dang*/ chos rje sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa'i mdor bsdus pa'i cho ga'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ dge slong 'phags pa zhes bya bas sa pho stag gi lo smin drug zla ba'i tshes gsum gyi nyin par dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ye shes seng ge zhes bya'o// // ༄༅/ /mdor byas kyi sa bcad bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /'di la gnyis te srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa dang*/ lha bsgom pa'o | | de la gnyis/ stong pa nyid du bsgom pa dang*/ dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor ro | | de la gnyis/ rten gzhal yas khang du bskyed pa dang*/ brten pa lha bsgom pa'o | | dang po la ∶ dngos gzhi bsgrub pa ( dang ) 'o/ /gzhal yas khang bskyed pa gdan bsgom pa'o/ /lha bskyed pa la gsum/ sbyong ba dang*/ (《 zha 》 gsum/ sgrub pa/ gzhal yas khang bskyed pa/ gdan sgom pa'o/ /dang po sbyor ba dang*/ ) dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang*/ las rgyal mchog go /dang po la gsum/ lhag par mos pa pha mes kyi ting nge 'dzin rnal 'byor rnam bzhi/ bu tsha'i ting nge 'dzin rjes su chags pa sngon du 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /bar pa la bzhi/ rnal 'byor dang rjes su rnal 'byor dang | shin tu rnal 'byor dang*/ rnal 'byor chen po'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor la 'jug pa dang*/ lha'i rgyu mthun bsgom pa'o/ /rjes su rnal 'byor ni rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom pa nyid do/

/shin tu rnal 'byor la gnyis | rdo rje mgon po sgyur ba dang*/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'o/ /rnal 'byor chen po la gnyis/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs bsgom pa'o/ /gsum pa rjes su chags pa sngon du 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin la lnga/ rig ma 'du bya ba/ rdo rje dang pad+ma byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ las la gnas pa/ mchod pa bya ba/ bha gar lha bskyed pa'o/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog ni/ lha re re zhing dbyung ba/ spro ba/ bsdu ba/ gsal gdab pa ste bzhi bzhi'o | | gsum pa las rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin la bdun/ phra mo'i rnal 'byor dang*/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang*/ ngag gis bzlas pa dang*/ don dam par 'jug pa dang*/ lha mo'i glus bslang ba dang*/ bstod cing mchod pa dang*/ nye bar bsdu ba'o// // ༈ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi snying po'i gzungs/ / na mo dhar+m+ma kā ya sam+bhā+o ga kā ya nir+m+mā ṇa kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ dā na pā ra mi tā/ shī la pā ra mi tā/ k+ṣān+ti pā ra mi tā/ bīr+ya pā ra mi tā/ dh+yā na pā ra mi tā/ pradz+nyā pā ra mi tā/ sarba dhar+m+ma shū n+ya tā swā hā// // ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya wa data/ te ṣāñca yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ ༄༅/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dbang rab tu gsal ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dbang rab tu gsal ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mor spyi bos gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang*/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum sbyor ba | | gsang ba 'dus pa bde chen por/ /phyag 'tshal nas ni 'dis 'dul ba'i | | skye bo skal pa can don tu/ /dbang bskur ba yi cho ga'i rim/ /lung dang man ngag las rtogs nas/ /shin tu gsal bar bdag gis bshad/ /phyi rol nyid dang nang dang ni/

/rgyu dang 'bras bu bsre ba dang*/ /sku bzhi'i sa bon gdab pa'i phyir/ /rgyud kun las ni dbang rab bsngags/ /'thor phyir dri ma sbyong ba'i phyir | | lam la dbang phyir dngos grub kyi/ /skal pa ster phyir mchog gi ni/ /go 'phang nyid la 'jog phyir dbang*/ /lam la sbyor bar byed pa dang*/ /kun nas goms par byed pa dang*/ /mi 'phrogs pa la sbyor ba ste/ /dbang bskur rnam pa gsum du bshad/ /go rim kun nas nges pa'i phyir/ /snga ma med par phyi ma min | | de bas dbang bskur med par lam/ /sgrub pa lung las rnam par smad/ /sngags dang rgyud dang man ngag 'dzin/ /cho ga'i las la rab tu mkhas/ /snying rjes slob ma rjes 'dzin pa/ /dbang bskur ba yi slob dpon mchog /dad dang snying rjes sems rab dul/ /rnam rtog chung zhing blo dang ldan/ /sngags kyi lam gyi mchog don gnyer/ /mthun zhing grangs dang ldan pa gzung*/ /sbyor ba dang ni dngos gzhi dang | | de bzhin rjes kyi bya ba ste/ /cho ga'i yan lag phun tshogs pa'i | | dbang bskur ba yis 'bras rab ster/ /gsol dang bsnyen pa'i las dang ni | | sa gzhi yongs su gzung ba dang*/ /lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga ste/ /sbyor ba'i yan lag rnam pa bzhi/ /de la thog mar slob ma dad pa dang ldan pas bla ma la yan lag lngas phyag byas te/ maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro ba'i me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar la/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyong ba/ /de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gyis/ /gtso bo bdag la bka' drin skyobs | | zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab pa dang*/ bla mas khyod kyi bsam pa dag pas yo byad thams cad phun sum tshogs par gyis shig dang*/ kho bos kyang ji ltar nus pas rjes su gzung bar bya'o/ /zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba la 'jug par dbang zhing bar du gcod pa thams cad las rgyal ba dang*/ slob ma'i rgyud byin gyis rlob pa la nus pa dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir/

sngon du bsnyen pa'i las brtsam par bya'o/ /'di'ang bum pa la brten pa'i phyogs ni/ 'chad par 'gyur ba'i bum pa sta gon du gnas pa dang 'dra zhing*/ ma brten pa'i phyogs ni sgrub pa'i thabs nas 'byung ba dang mthun la/ ji srid du mtshan ma mthong ba de srid du bzla ba'am/ yang na gtso bo la 'bum phrag gcig dang | 'khor rnams la khri phrag re bzla'o/ /bsnyen pa'o/ /sa gzhi brtag dang bslang ba dang*/ /sbyang dang byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ /yongs su gzung dang bsrung ba ste/ /sa yi cho ga rnam pa drug /de la brtag pa ni dbyibs zlum po dang gru bzhi shar dang byang du gzhol ba/ kha dog dkar zhing snum pa rdo rje dang*/ nor bu dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ dga' ba 'khyil pa la sogs pa'i mtshan mas brgyan zhing*/ me tog dang 'bras bus spud pa'i ljon shing gis rnam par bkra ba/ chu klung g.yas su 'khyil pas yongs su bskor ba/ dben zhing nyams dga' la yo byad phun sum tshogs shing mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'tshe ba dang bral ba'i sa phyogs rang gi yid 'jug pa dkyil 'khor gyi gnas su shes nas/ rmi lam gyi ltas brtag pa'i phyir/ sa phyogs de nyid du khru gang pa'i maṇ+ḍal ba las byung ba lngas legs par byugs la/ dbus su dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i me tog tshom bu sum cu so gcig dang*/ khor yug tu phyogs skyong bcu'i mtshan ma me tog tshom bu bcu dgod/ gtor ma gnyis dang mchod pa bshams te/ bdag gi rnal 'byor sngon du 'gro bas dbus kyi me tog gi tshom bu rnams/ dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par lhag par dmigs la/ ye shes pa dang gnyis su med par byas nas/ byin gyis brlabs la dbang bskur te/ mchod pa dang gtor mas mnyes par byas nas/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sar btsugs te/ spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas 'di skad ces/ dgongs shig dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod pa dang*/ /slob ma rnams la phan don du/

/bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bri bar bgyi | | rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams kyis/ /bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol | | zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab nas/ phyi rol gyi tshom bu bcu po phyogs skyong bcur dmigs te/ so so'i ming gi mthar/ ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥzhes pa'i sngags dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ phyag rgyas rang bzhin du gnas pa dang gnyis su med par byas la/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i gtor ma bstabs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ in+d+rā ya swā hā/ oṃ ya mā ya swā hā/ oṃ ba ru ṇā ya swā hā/ oṃ ku be rā ya swā hā/ oṃ ag+nā ya swā hā/ oṃ nai t+ya rāk+ṣa sa a dhi pa tā ya swā hā/ oṃ bā ya be swā hā/ oṃ ī sha nā ya swā hā/ tsan+d+rā yā di t+yai swā hā/ (《 lu 》+ oṃ pur ya grwa na ye swā hā/ ) oṃ pṛ th+wī de w+yai swā hā/ zhes pa a kā ro dang bcas pa lan gsum gyis dbul lo | | slar yang mchod nas/ khams gsum bzhugs pa'i lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin dri za lha ma yin/ / gang dag rdzu 'phrul cher ldan rnams/ /rdo rje spyan dang snyan mnga' dang*/ /sa la gnas pa'i 'byung po kun/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol | | bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /sangs rgyas rnams la mchod pa dang*/ /sems can rnams la phan don du/ /sa phyogs dge gnas 'di nyid du/ /dam pa'i dkyil 'khor cher 'byung ba/ /ji ltar bsam pa'i las byed na/ khyed kyis bar chad ma byed par/ /dge ba'i grogs po nyid du mdzod/ /de ltar khyed la bdag gis ni/ /bzod par gsol gyis mi bslu bar/ /rmi lam la sogs mtshan ma rnams/ / legs nyes ltas rnams bstan du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab nas | maṇ+ḍal de nyid la mgo bstan te/ gzhogs g.yas pa 'og tu bcug la rnam par rtog pa gzhan gyis ma g.yengs par gnyid log go /rmi lam dge ba mthong na de nyid du btsal zhing*/ gal te mi dge ba mthong na gzhan du btsal lo
